BFO:0000001.label: entity
BFO:0000001.definition: (Elucidation) An entity is anything that exists or has existed or will exist

BFO:0000002.label: continuant
BFO:0000002.definition: (Elucidation) A continuant is an entity that persists, endures, or continues to exist through time while maintaining its identity

BFO:0000003.label: occurrent
BFO:0000003.definition: (Elucidation) An occurrent is an entity that unfolds itself in time or it is the start or end of such an entity or it is a temporal or spatiotemporal region

BFO:0000004.label: independent continuant
BFO:0000004.definition: b is an independent continuant =Def b is a continuant & there is no c such that b specifically depends on c or b generically depends on c

BFO:0000006.label: spatial region
BFO:0000006.definition: (Elucidation) A spatial region is a continuant entity that is a continuant part of the spatial projection of a portion of spacetime at a given time

BFO:0000008.label: temporal region
BFO:0000008.definition: (Elucidation) A temporal region is an occurrent over which processes can unfold

BFO:0000009.label: two-dimensional spatial region
BFO:0000009.definition: (Elucidation) A two-dimensional spatial region is a spatial region that is a whole consisting of a surface together with zero or more surfaces which may have spatial regions of lower dimension as parts

BFO:0000011.label: spatiotemporal region
BFO:0000011.definition: (Elucidation) A spatiotemporal region is an occurrent that is an occurrent part of spacetime

BFO:0000015.label: process
BFO:0000015.definition: (Elucidation) p is a process means p is an occurrent that has some temporal proper part and for some time t, p has some material entity as participant

BFO:0000016.label: disposition
BFO:0000016.definition: (Elucidation) A disposition b is a realizable entity such that if b ceases to exist then its bearer is physically changed & b's realization occurs when and because this bearer is in some special physical circumstances & this realization occurs in virtue of the bearer's physical make-up

BFO:0000017.label: realizable entity
BFO:0000017.definition: (Elucidation) A realizable entity is a specifically dependent continuant that inheres in some independent continuant which is not a spatial region & which is of a type some instances of which are realized in processes of a correlated type

BFO:0000018.label: zero-dimensional spatial region
BFO:0000018.definition: (Elucidation) A zero-dimensional spatial region is one or a collection of more than one spatially disjoint points in space

BFO:0000019.label: quality
BFO:0000019.definition: (Elucidation) A quality is a specifically dependent continuant that, in contrast to roles and dispositions, does not require any further process in order to be realized

BFO:0000020.label: specifically dependent continuant
BFO:0000020.definition: b is a specifically dependent continuant =Def b is a continuant & there is some independent continuant c which is not a spatial region & which is such that b specifically depends on c

BFO:0000023.label: role
BFO:0000023.definition: (Elucidation) A role b is a realizable entity such that b exists because there is some single bearer that is in some special physical, social, or institutional set of circumstances in which this bearer does not have to be & b is not such that, if it ceases to exist, then the physical make-up of the bearer is thereby changed

BFO:0000024.label: fiat object part
BFO:0000024.definition: (Elucidation) A fiat object part b is a material entity & such that if b exists then it is continuant part of some object c & demarcated from the remainder of c by one or more fiat surfaces

BFO:0000026.label: one-dimensional spatial region
BFO:0000026.definition: (Elucidation) A one-dimensional spatial region is a whole consisting of a line together with zero or more lines which may have points as parts

BFO:0000027.label: object aggregate
BFO:0000027.definition: (Elucidation) An object aggregate is a material entity consisting exactly of a plurality (≥1) of objects as member parts which together form a unit

BFO:0000028.label: three-dimensional spatial region
BFO:0000028.definition: (Elucidation) A three-dimensional spatial region is a whole consisting of a spatial volume together with zero or more spatial volumes which may have spatial regions of lower dimension as parts

BFO:0000029.label: site
BFO:0000029.definition: (Elucidation) A site is a three-dimensional immaterial entity whose boundaries either (partially or wholly) coincide with the boundaries of one or more material entities or have locations determined in relation to some material entity

BFO:0000030.label: object
BFO:0000030.definition: (Elucidation) An object is a material entity which manifests causal unity & is of a type instances of which are maximal relative to the sort of causal unity manifested

BFO:0000031.label: generically dependent continuant
BFO:0000031.definition: (Elucidation) A generically dependent continuant is an entity that exists in virtue of the fact that there is at least one of what may be multiple copies which is the content or the pattern that multiple copies would share

BFO:0000034.label: function
BFO:0000034.definition: (Elucidation) A function is a disposition that exists in virtue of its bearer's physical make-up & this physical make-up is something the bearer possesses because it came into being either through evolution (in the case of natural biological entities) or through intentional design (in the case of artefacts) in order to realize processes of a certain sort

BFO:0000035.label: process boundary
BFO:0000035.definition: p is a process boundary =Def p is a temporal part of a process & p has no proper temporal parts

BFO:0000038.label: one-dimensional temporal region
BFO:0000038.definition: (Elucidation) A one-dimensional temporal region is a temporal region that is a whole that has a temporal interval and zero or more temporal intervals and temporal instants as parts

BFO:0000040.label: material entity
BFO:0000040.definition: (Elucidation) A material entity is an independent continuant that at all times at which it exists has some portion of matter as continuant part

BFO:0000140.label: continuant fiat boundary
BFO:0000140.definition: (Elucidation) A continuant fiat boundary b is an immaterial entity that is of zero, one or two dimensions & such that there is no time t when b has a spatial region as continuant part & whose location is determined in relation to some material entity

BFO:0000141.label: immaterial entity
BFO:0000141.definition: b is an immaterial entity =Def b is an independent continuant which is such that there is no time t when it has a material entity as continuant part

BFO:0000142.label: fiat line
BFO:0000142.definition: (Elucidation) A fiat line is a one-dimensional continuant fiat boundary that is continuous

BFO:0000144.label: Process Profile
BFO:0000144.definition: An occurrent that is an occurrent part of some process by virtue of the rate, or pattern, or magnitude of change in an attribute of one or more participants of said process.

BFO:0000145.label: relational quality
BFO:0000145.definition: b is a relational quality =Def b is a quality & there exists c and d such that c and d are not identical & b specifically depends on c & b specifically depends on d

BFO:0000146.label: fiat surface
BFO:0000146.definition: (Elucidation) A fiat surface is a two-dimensional continuant fiat boundary that is self-connected

BFO:0000147.label: fiat point
BFO:0000147.definition: (Elucidation) A fiat point is a zero-dimensional continuant fiat boundary that consists of a single point

BFO:0000148.label: zero-dimensional temporal region
BFO:0000148.definition: (Elucidation) A zero-dimensional temporal region is a temporal region that is a whole consisting of one or more separated temporal instants as parts

BFO:0000182.label: history
BFO:0000182.definition: (Elucidation) A history is a process that is the sum of the totality of processes taking place in the spatiotemporal region occupied by the material part of a material entity

BFO:0000202.label: temporal interval
BFO:0000202.definition: (Elucidation) A temporal interval is a one-dimensional temporal region that is continuous, thus without gaps or breaks

BFO:0000203.label: temporal instant
BFO:0000203.definition: (Elucidation) A temporal instant is a zero-dimensional temporal region that has no proper temporal part

cco:ont00000001.label: Deflecting Prism
cco:ont00000001.definition: A Prism designed to deflect a beam of light entering the Prism by a fixed angle.

cco:ont00000002.label: Cooling Artifact Function
cco:ont00000002.definition: An Artifact Function that is realized in a process in which the thermal energy of a system decreases.

cco:ont00000003.label: Designative Name
cco:ont00000003.definition: A Designative Information Content Entity that consists of a string of characters that designates an entity within a specified cultural or social namespace and which is typically a word or phrase in a natural language that has an accepted cultural or social significance.

cco:ont00000004.label: Change
cco:ont00000004.definition: A Process in which some independent continuant endures and 1) one or more of the dependent entities it bears increase or decrease in intensity, 2) the entity begins to bear some dependent entity or 3) the entity ceases to bear some dependent entity.

cco:ont00000005.label: Act
cco:ont00000005.definition: A Process in which at least one Agent plays a causative role.

cco:ont00000006.label: Upper Midrange Frequency
cco:ont00000006.definition: A Sonic Frequency that is between 2 and 4 kHz.

cco:ont00000007.label: Natural Process
cco:ont00000007.definition: A Process existing in or produced by nature; rather than by the intent of human beings.

cco:ont00000008.label: Sound Frequency
cco:ont00000008.definition: A Frequency that is the rate of Oscillations per second of a Sound Wave.

cco:ont00000009.label: Mass Density
cco:ont00000009.definition: A Quality that inheres in a bearer in virtue of that bearer's mass per unit volume.

cco:ont00000010.label: Incorporated Organization
cco:ont00000010.definition: An Organization formed by an Act of Incorporation that consists of an association of individuals, created by law or under authority of law, having a continuous existence independent of the existences of its members and owners, and having powers and liabilities distinct from those of its members and owners.

cco:ont00000011.label: Nominal Stasis
cco:ont00000011.definition: A Stasis of Specifically Dependent Continuant in which some Independent Continuant bears a Quality or Realizable Entity that has a level of intensity or functionality that falls within the designed, expected, or acceptable range such that the Independent Continuant is of normal value, usefulness, or functionality.

cco:ont00000012.label: Propulsion Control System
cco:ont00000012.definition: A Control System that consists of control devices, displays, indicators, or modules designed to control a Propulsion System.

cco:ont00000013.label: Gain of Generically Dependent Continuant
cco:ont00000013.definition: A Gain of Dependent Continuant wherein some Independent Continuant becomes the carrier of some Generically Dependent Continuant.

cco:ont00000015.label: Shotgun
cco:ont00000015.definition: A Long Gun that fires packets of shot, a single slug, a sabot, or a specialty round (such as tear gas, bolo shell, or a breaching round) over shorter ranges than that of Rifles and with less accuracy.

cco:ont00000016.label: Triangular Waveform
cco:ont00000016.definition: A Waveform that is characterized by a triangular shape due to the continuous linear zig-zag transitions between minimum and maximum Amplitudes of the Wave Cycle.

cco:ont00000017.label: Minor Axis
cco:ont00000017.definition: A One-Dimensional Spatial Region that is the longest line segment perpendicular to the Major Axis that connects two points on the edge of an Ellipse.

cco:ont00000018.label: Title Document
cco:ont00000018.definition: A Legal Instrument that is designed as evidence of ownership.

cco:ont00000019.label: Power Inverting Artifact Function
cco:ont00000019.definition: A Current Conversion Artifact Function that is realized by processes in which some Material Artifact is used to convert direct current (DC) to alternating current (AC).

cco:ont00000020.label: Container
cco:ont00000020.definition: A Material Artifact that is designed to contain (wholly or partially) some material entity.

cco:ont00000021.label: Sensor Platform
cco:ont00000021.definition: A Material Entity that bears a Sensor Platform Artifact Function or Sensor Platform Role.

cco:ont00000022.label: Radio Communication Reception Artifact Function
cco:ont00000022.definition: A Communication Reception Artifact Function that is realized during events in which a Material Artifact receives information transmitted from another Material Artifact, where the transmission of information occurs using radio waves.

cco:ont00000023.label: Sensor Deployment Artifact Function
cco:ont00000023.definition: An Artifact Function that inheres in Material Artifacts that are designed to support or convey one or more Sensors while the Sensors are realizing their own Artifact Functions.

cco:ont00000024.label: Act of Advising
cco:ont00000024.definition: An Act of Directive Communication performed by providing advice or counsel to another agent.

cco:ont00000026.label: Hair Color
cco:ont00000026.definition: A Quality inhering in a portion of Hair by virtue of its color.

cco:ont00000027.label: Mailing
cco:ont00000027.definition: An Act of Communication by Media in which information concretized in tangible objects, usually written documents, are delivered to recipients.

cco:ont00000028.label: Dispersive Prism
cco:ont00000028.definition: A Prism designed to break up a beam of light entering the Prism into its constituent spectral colors by leveraging the refractive index of light based on its Frequency.

cco:ont00000029.label: Median Point Estimate Information Content Entity
cco:ont00000029.definition: A Point Estimate Information Content Entity that is a measurement of a set of values and is equal to either the middle value or the average of the two values which separate the set into two equally populated upper and lower sets.

cco:ont00000030.label: Nuclear Reactor
cco:ont00000030.definition: A Power Source that is designed to initiate and control a self-sustained nuclear chain reaction to produce power in the form of heat, which can be transferred to a working fluid for further conversion to mechanical or electrical energy.

cco:ont00000031.label: Atmospheric Feature
cco:ont00000031.definition: A Geographic Feature that is part of the atmosphere (including the atmosphere itself as a non-proper part) having a relatively stable lifecycle and which has a location that can be distinguished from the surrounding portion of the atmosphere.

cco:ont00000032.label: Church
cco:ont00000032.definition: A Religious Facility that is designed for Christian worship and prayer.

cco:ont00000033.label: Decrease of Role
cco:ont00000033.definition: A Decrease of Realizable Entity in which some Independent Continuant has a decrease of some Role that it bears.

cco:ont00000034.label: Conveyance Artifact Function
cco:ont00000034.definition: A Motion Artifact Function that is realized in a process in which the bearer of the function conveys entities from one location to another.

cco:ont00000035.label: Soft X-ray Frequency
cco:ont00000035.definition: An X-Ray Frequency that is between 30 petahertz and 3 exahertz.

cco:ont00000036.label: Waste Management Artifact Function
cco:ont00000036.definition: A Service Artifact Function that is realized in processes of collecting, transporting, processing, recycling, monitoring, or disposing of waste materials.

cco:ont00000037.label: Act of Observation
cco:ont00000037.definition: A Planned Act of acquiring information from a source via the use of one or more senses.

cco:ont00000038.label: System Role
cco:ont00000038.definition: A Role that inheres in an entity in virtue of its parts or elements being arranged in such a way that they together exhibit behavior or meaning that they do not exhibit individually.

cco:ont00000039.label: Portion of Solid Fuel
cco:ont00000039.definition: A Portion of Fuel that is stored in a solid state.

cco:ont00000040.label: Grocery Store
cco:ont00000040.definition: A Commercial Facility that is designed to sell food.

cco:ont00000041.label: Hostel
cco:ont00000041.definition: A Residential Facility that is designed to temporarily lodge guests in a sociable environment for relatively low costs.

cco:ont00000042.label: Semicircular
cco:ont00000042.definition: A Shape quality inhering in a bearer in virtue of the bearer having the shape of half a circle.

cco:ont00000043.label: Portion of Solid Propellant
cco:ont00000043.definition: A Portion of Propellant that is stored in a solid state.

cco:ont00000044.label: Eye Color
cco:ont00000044.definition: A Quality inhering in an Eye by virtue of the color of the Eye's Iris.

cco:ont00000045.label: Petroleum Depot
cco:ont00000045.definition: A Storage Facility that is designed to store petroleum, oil, or lubricants.

cco:ont00000046.label: Province
cco:ont00000046.definition: A First-Order Administrative Region that is part of a Country and delimits the authority of a magistrate who holds constitutionally-defined administrative jurisdiction over the defined geographic territory that bounds the Province.

cco:ont00000047.label: Flow Control Valve
cco:ont00000047.definition: A Valve that is designed to regulate the flow or Pressure of a fluid.

cco:ont00000048.label: Random Wire Antenna
cco:ont00000048.definition: A Wire Antenna that consists of a long wire suspended above the ground with a length that does not bear a relation to the wavelength of the radio waves used and which is typically used as a receiving antenna on the long, medium, and short wave bands.

cco:ont00000049.label: Banknote
cco:ont00000049.definition: A Portion of Cash that consists of a portable slips of paper or fabric designed to bear some specified Financial Value.

cco:ont00000050.label: Very High Frequency Communication Instrument
cco:ont00000050.definition: A Radio Communication Instrument that is designed to participate in some process that has process part some Very High Frequency.

cco:ont00000051.label: Act of Construction
cco:ont00000051.definition: An Act of Material Artifact Processing wherein Material Artifacts are built on site as prescribed by some contract.

cco:ont00000052.label: Religious Facility
cco:ont00000052.definition: A Facility that is designed for worship and prayer.

cco:ont00000053.label: Ground Motor Vehicle
cco:ont00000053.definition: A Ground Vehicle that is designed to receive its motive power from an Engine and is not designed to travel on rails.

cco:ont00000054.label: Stirling Engine
cco:ont00000054.definition: An External Combusion Engine that is designed to compress and expand some working fluid at different temperatures, such that there is a net conversion of heat energy to mechanical work.

cco:ont00000055.label: Healthcare Facility
cco:ont00000055.definition: A Facility that is designed for the diagnosis, treatment, and prevention of disease.

cco:ont00000056.label: Reaction Engine
cco:ont00000056.definition: An Engine that provides propulsion by expelling Reaction Mass.

cco:ont00000057.label: Mobile Telephone
cco:ont00000057.definition: A Telephone that is connected to a Telephone Network by radio waves.

cco:ont00000058.label: Scalp Hair
cco:ont00000058.definition: A Bodily Component that consists of a portion of hair that grows on the scalp of a human or other animal.

cco:ont00000059.label: Telephone Line
cco:ont00000059.definition: A Telecommunication Network Line that consists of a physical wire or other signaling medium that is designed to be part of a Telephone Network.

cco:ont00000060.label: Open Pit Mine
cco:ont00000060.definition: A Mine that is designed to support the extraction of materials from the ground directly without using tunnels.

cco:ont00000061.label: Measurement Unit of Flow
cco:ont00000061.definition: A Measurement Unit that is used as a standard for measurement of the rate at which portions of a substance pass per unit of time.

cco:ont00000062.label: Frequency Measurement Artifact Function
cco:ont00000062.definition: A Measurement Artifact Function that is realized during events in which a Material Artifact is used to measure the Frequency of a specified object or class of objects.

cco:ont00000063.label: Multi-Hour Temporal Interval
cco:ont00000063.definition: A one-dimensional temporal region that is measured in Hours and spans at least one Hour.

cco:ont00000064.label: Material Copy of a Book
cco:ont00000064.definition: A Material Copy of a Document that is designed to carry some specific Information Content Entity by means of ink, paper, parchment, or other materials fastened together to hinge at one side.

cco:ont00000065.label: Act of Location Change
cco:ont00000065.definition: An Act of Motion in which the location of some Object is changed by some Agent.

cco:ont00000066.label: Military Artifact Function
cco:ont00000066.definition: A Service Artifact Function that is realized in processes related to the armed services.

cco:ont00000067.label: Civil Time Reference System
cco:ont00000067.definition: A Temporal Reference System that is a statutory time scale as designated by civilian authorities to determine local time(s).

cco:ont00000068.label: Three-Dimensional Path
cco:ont00000068.definition: A Three-Dimensional Spatial Region that encompasses the spatial region through which some Object travels.

cco:ont00000069.label: Material Copy of a Transcript
cco:ont00000069.definition: A Material Copy of a Document that is designed to carry some specific Information Content Entity that was originally recorded in a different medium.

cco:ont00000070.label: Ground Track Point
cco:ont00000070.definition: A Zero-Dimensional Spatial Region that is an idealized point located on the surface of an Astronomical Body directly below an Object Track Point.

cco:ont00000071.label: Town
cco:ont00000071.definition: A Local Administrative Region in which a human population permanently resides that is typically larger than the population of a Village but smaller than that of a City; is designated as a town based on a particular administrative, legal, or historical status; and which delimits a local Government that typically exercises less power than that of a City Government.

cco:ont00000072.label: Low Density Residential Area
cco:ont00000072.definition: A Populated Place where houses are on lots of more than one acre.

cco:ont00000073.label: Temporal Interval Identifier
cco:ont00000073.definition: A Temporal Region Identifier that designates some Temporal Interval.

cco:ont00000074.label: Measurement Unit of Acceleration
cco:ont00000074.definition: A Measurement Unit that is used as a standard for measurement of the rate at which objects change their velocities per unit of time.

cco:ont00000075.label: Optical Microscope
cco:ont00000075.definition: A Microscope that is designed to use visible light and a system of Optical Lenses to produce a significantly enlarged image of the Object.

cco:ont00000076.label: Wired Communication Artifact Function
cco:ont00000076.definition: A Communication Artifact Function that is realized in a process that conveys meaningful signs by means of a (usually cylindrical) flexible strand or rod of metal.

cco:ont00000077.label: Code Identifier
cco:ont00000077.definition: A Non-Name Identifier that consists of a string of characters that was created and assigned according to an encoding system such that metadata can be derived from the identifier.

cco:ont00000078.label: Act of Estimation
cco:ont00000078.definition: An Act of Measuring that involves the comparison of a measurement of a similar Entity or of a portion of the Entity being estimated to produce an approximated measurement of the target Entity.

cco:ont00000079.label: Act of Social Movement
cco:ont00000079.definition: A Social Act composed of a series of performances, displays and campaigns directed at implementing, resisting or undoing a change in society.

cco:ont00000080.label: Standard Time of Day Identifier
cco:ont00000080.definition: A Time of Day Identifier that designates an approximate Temporal Instant that is part of some Day and is specified using the Hours, Minutes, and Seconds of the Day that preceded the Temporal Instant.

cco:ont00000081.label: Cutting Weapon
cco:ont00000081.definition: A Weapon that is designed to inflict harm, damage, or incapacity by means of separating some portion of its target into two or more portions through the application of acutely directed force.

cco:ont00000082.label: Green
cco:ont00000082.definition: A Color that is between Yellow and Cyan with a wavelength in the visible spectrum, typically between 520 to 560 nanometers.

cco:ont00000083.label: Process Ending
cco:ont00000083.definition: A Process Boundary that occupies a Zero-Dimensional Temporal Region that is the ending instant of the One-Dimensional Temporal Region that the Process, of which the Process Boundary is a part, occupies.

cco:ont00000084.label: Bodily Component
cco:ont00000084.definition: A Fiat Object Part located within or on the surface of an Agent.

cco:ont00000085.label: Minute
cco:ont00000085.definition: A Temporal Interval that is equal to sixty consecutive Seconds.

cco:ont00000086.label: Autopilot System
cco:ont00000086.definition: A Vehicle Control System that is designed to enable some Agent to control the trajectory of a Vehicle without constant 'hands-on' control.

cco:ont00000087.label: Ordinal Date Identifier
cco:ont00000087.definition: A Decimal Date Identifier that designates some Day by using a number to indicate the sequential ordering of the Day since the beginning of the Year.

cco:ont00000088.label: Firearm
cco:ont00000088.definition: A Projectile Launcher that is designed to launch Bullets or Cartridges.

cco:ont00000089.label: Skill
cco:ont00000089.definition: An Agent Capability that inheres in a Person to the extent of that Person's capacity to realize it in Intentional Acts of a certain type.

cco:ont00000090.label: Infrared Telescope
cco:ont00000090.definition: A Telescope that is designed to aid in the observation of spatially distant Objects by means of collecting and focusing infrared light to form an enhanced image of the Object.

cco:ont00000091.label: Portion of Coolant
cco:ont00000091.definition: A Portion of Material that is designed to be used in a thermal control system to reduce or maintain the temperature of an object to or at a specified level.

cco:ont00000092.label: Bidirectional Transducer
cco:ont00000092.definition: A Transducer that is designed to receive a signal in the form of physical phenomena and convert it into an electrical signal, and vice versa.

cco:ont00000093.label: Preferred Stock
cco:ont00000093.definition: Stock that entitles its holder to receive a certain level of dividend payments before any dividends can be issued to other holders.

cco:ont00000094.label: Seat of National Government
cco:ont00000094.definition: A Government Building that is designed for the administration of a sovereign nation.

cco:ont00000095.label: Control Surface
cco:ont00000095.definition: A Material Artifact that is designed to deflect air, water, or another medium around its surface in order to change the Attitude of a Vehicle by rotating the Vehicle on one or more of its Axes of Rotation.

cco:ont00000096.label: Propulsion System
cco:ont00000096.definition: A Material Artifact that is designed to facilitate the movement of material entities from one location to another and which consists of a source of mechanical power and a means of converting this power into propulsive force to generate the movement.

cco:ont00000097.label: Complex Optical Lens
cco:ont00000097.definition: An Optical Lens consisting of more than one Simple Optical Lenses.

cco:ont00000098.label: Electrical Artifact Function
cco:ont00000098.definition: An Artifact Function that is realized during events in which a Material Artifact is used to perform a process involving electrical power.

cco:ont00000099.label: Wave Process
cco:ont00000099.definition: A Natural Process that involves Oscillation accompanied by a transfer of energy that travels through a portion of matter or spatial region.

cco:ont00000100.label: Stasis of Partially Mission Capable
cco:ont00000100.definition: A Stasis of Mission Capability during which the participating Continuant is capable of performing some but not all of its primary functions for the specified Mission.

cco:ont00000101.label: Portion of Liquid Oxygen
cco:ont00000101.definition: A Portion of Cryogenic Material that is composed (almost) entirely of liquid oxygen.

cco:ont00000102.label: Skin Type
cco:ont00000102.definition: A Quality inhering in a portion of skin by virtue of its color and natural tendency to respond to ultraviolet light.

cco:ont00000103.label: Vehicle Compartment
cco:ont00000103.definition: A Material Artifact that is designed to partition a Vehicle into subdivisions for various purposes.

cco:ont00000104.label: Underwater Mine
cco:ont00000104.definition: A Mine that is designed to support the extraction of materials from the ocean floor.

cco:ont00000105.label: Square
cco:ont00000105.definition: A Rectangular shape which has four equal length sides and four 90 degree angles.

cco:ont00000106.label: End of Life Stasis
cco:ont00000106.definition: A Stasis of Artifact Operationality that holds during a Temporal Interval when the participating Material Artifact is no longer capable of realizing all of its designed primary Artifact Functions.

cco:ont00000107.label: Increase of Generically Dependent Continuant
cco:ont00000107.definition: An Increase of Dependent Continuant in which some Independent Continuant has an increase of some Generically Dependent Continuant that it bears.

cco:ont00000108.label: Rail Facility
cco:ont00000108.definition: A Transportation Facility that is designed for transferring people or cargo to and from Trains.

cco:ont00000109.label: Act of Military Force
cco:ont00000109.definition: A Planned Act of employing a Military Force to achieve some desired result.

cco:ont00000110.label: Mechanical Process
cco:ont00000110.definition: A Process that is the realization of some Disposition of a Material Artifact.

cco:ont00000111.label: Air Inlet
cco:ont00000111.definition: A Fluid Control Artifact that consists of an opening that is designed to capture and direct the flow of air into the system it is part of.

cco:ont00000112.label: Translucent
cco:ont00000112.definition: An Opacity that inheres in a bearer in virtue of that bearer's capacity to transmit some but not all electromagnetic radiation of a given frequency through the bearer such that the bearer reflects, scatters, or absorbs some but not all electromagnetic radiation of that frequency.

cco:ont00000113.label: Ventilation Control Artifact Function
cco:ont00000113.definition: An Artifact Function that is realized in processes in which some Material Artifact is used to control the quality of air in some space.

cco:ont00000114.label: Unix Temporal Instant
cco:ont00000114.definition: A Temporal Instant as specified by the number of Seconds that have elapsed since the specified Epoch Time as described by an implementation of Unix Time.

cco:ont00000115.label: Stasis of Disposition
cco:ont00000115.definition: A Stasis of Realizable Entity in which some Independent Continuant bears some Disposition that remains unchanged during a Temporal Interval.

cco:ont00000116.label: Pump
cco:ont00000116.definition: A Fluid Control Artifact that is designed to impart motion to a portion of fluid to transport it within a system through the use of mechanical action.

cco:ont00000117.label: Information Processing Artifact
cco:ont00000117.definition: A Material Artifact that is designed to use algorithms to transform some Information Content Entity into another Information Content Entity.

cco:ont00000118.label: Artifact Function Specification
cco:ont00000118.definition: A Prescriptive Information Content Entity that prescribes some Material Artifact Function and which is part of some Material Artifact Model.

cco:ont00000119.label: Spatial Orientation
cco:ont00000119.definition: A Relational Quality that is the angle of Rotation of an Object relative to one or more Plane of Reference or Axis of Rotation.

cco:ont00000120.label: Measurement Unit
cco:ont00000120.definition: A Descriptive Information Content Entity that describes a definite magnitude of a physical quantity, defined and adopted by convention and/or by law, that is used as a standard for measurement of the same physical quantity.

cco:ont00000121.label: Act of Conducting Mass Media Interview
cco:ont00000121.definition: An Act of Mass Media Communication involving a conversation between a reporter and a person of public interest, used as a basis of a broadcast or publication.

cco:ont00000122.label: Vehicle Track Point
cco:ont00000122.definition: An Object Track Point that is where a Vehicle is or was located during some motion.

cco:ont00000123.label: Act of Expressive Communication
cco:ont00000123.definition: An Act of Communication in which an Agent expresses their attitudes or emotions towards some entity.

cco:ont00000124.label: Solar Time Reference System
cco:ont00000124.definition: A Temporal Reference System that is based on the position of the Sun in the sky.

cco:ont00000125.label: Bounding Box Point
cco:ont00000125.definition: A Geospatial Position that is a proper part of some Geospatial Region Bounding Box.

cco:ont00000126.label: First-Order Administrative Region
cco:ont00000126.definition: A Government Domain that is a primary administrative division of a Country.

cco:ont00000127.label: Performance Specification
cco:ont00000127.definition: A Prescriptive Information Content Entity that prescribes some aspect of the behavior of a participant in a Process given one or more operating conditions.

cco:ont00000128.label: Portion of Liquid Hydrogen
cco:ont00000128.definition: A Portion of Cryogenic Material that is composed (almost) entirely of liquid hydrogen.

cco:ont00000129.label: Tattoo
cco:ont00000129.definition: A Bodily Component that consists of a typically permanent mark or design on a portion of skin that is created by a process of pricking and ingraining an indelible pigment or by raising scars.

cco:ont00000130.label: Power Transformer
cco:ont00000130.definition: A Material Artifact that is designed to transfer electrical energy between two or more circuits through electromagnetic induction.

cco:ont00000131.label: Increase of Quality
cco:ont00000131.definition: An Increase of Specifically Dependent Continuant in which some Indpendent Continuant has an increase of some Quality that it bears.

cco:ont00000132.label: Recording Device
cco:ont00000132.definition: An Information Processing Artifact that is designed to capture some information and store it in some recording format on some storage medium.

cco:ont00000133.label: Act of Directive Communication
cco:ont00000133.definition: An Act of Communication that is intended to cause the hearer to take a particular action.

cco:ont00000134.label: Third-Order Administrative Region
cco:ont00000134.definition: A Government Domain that is a subdivision of a Second-Order Administrative Region.

cco:ont00000135.label: Stasis of Specifically Dependent Continuant
cco:ont00000135.definition: A Stasis in which some Independent Continuant bears some Specifically Dependent Continuant that remains unchanged during a Temporal Interval.

cco:ont00000136.label: Optical Instrument
cco:ont00000136.definition: A Material Artifact that is designed to process light waves.

cco:ont00000137.label: Act of Financial Deposit
cco:ont00000137.definition: An Act of Financial Instrument Use wherein a Financial Instrument is transferred by an Agent (the Depositor) to another Agent to create a liability to be repaid to the Depositor through an Act of Financial Withdrawal.

cco:ont00000138.label: Maximum Power
cco:ont00000138.definition: A Power that is characterized by the maximum rate of Work, or Energy consumed, done in a given time period.

cco:ont00000139.label: Domain of a Country
cco:ont00000139.definition: A Government Domain that is associated with certain distinct political, ethnic, or cultural characteristics, and which delimits a Government that has legitimate authority over a Populace.

cco:ont00000140.label: Measurement Unit of Amount of Substance
cco:ont00000140.definition: A Measurement Unit that is used as a standard for measurement of the number of a specified type of particle in a portion of matter.

cco:ont00000141.label: Populace
cco:ont00000141.definition: A Group of Persons forming the total population of some Government Domain.

cco:ont00000142.label: Act of Government
cco:ont00000142.definition: A Planned Act that is initiated or supported by some Geopolitical Entity and enforced by some Government Agent.

cco:ont00000143.label: Cargo Cabin
cco:ont00000143.definition: A Vehicle Compartment that is used to store goods or materials during transportation.

cco:ont00000144.label: Act of Meeting
cco:ont00000144.definition: An Act of Association wherein two or more Persons assemble for some common purpose.

cco:ont00000145.label: Incendiary Weapon
cco:ont00000145.definition: A Weapon that is designed to inflict harm, damage, or incapacity by means of starting a fire.

cco:ont00000146.label: Artificial Language
cco:ont00000146.definition: A Language that is developed through conscious planning and premeditation, rather than one that was developed through use and repetition.

cco:ont00000147.label: Flight Transponder
cco:ont00000147.definition: A Radio Transponder that is designed to produce a specified response (typically for identification, location, or status update purposes) when it receives a radio-frequency interrogation.

cco:ont00000148.label: Clockwise Rotational Motion
cco:ont00000148.definition: A Rotational Motion in which the direction of rotation is toward the right as seen relative to the designated side of the plane of rotation.

cco:ont00000149.label: Instant Messaging
cco:ont00000149.definition: An Act of Communication Mediated by Artifact in which real-time direct text-based communication occurs between two or more Agents using personal computers or other devices, along with shared Instant Messaging Client Software conveyed over a computer network.

cco:ont00000150.label: Radio Frequency
cco:ont00000150.definition: An Electromagnetic Radiation Frequency of some Electromagnetic Wave that is between 3 kHz and 300 GHz.

cco:ont00000151.label: Act of Reporting
cco:ont00000151.definition: An Act of Representative Communication performed by giving a detailed account or statement.

cco:ont00000152.label: Telephone Network
cco:ont00000152.definition: A Telecommunication Network that is designed to allow telephone calls to be made between two or more parties connected to the network.

cco:ont00000153.label: Generator Control Unit
cco:ont00000153.definition: A Control System that is designed to regulate the voltage of some Electrical Power Source.

cco:ont00000154.label: Mode Point Estimate Information Content Entity
cco:ont00000154.definition: A Point Estimate Information Content Entity that is a measurement of a set of values and is equal to the value or values that occur most often in the set.

cco:ont00000155.label: Near Infrared Light Frequency
cco:ont00000155.definition: An Infrared Light Frequency that is between 214 and 400 terahertz.

cco:ont00000156.label: Hand Gun
cco:ont00000156.definition: A Firearm that is designed to have a relatively short barrel and to be held in one or two hands and to be fired without being braced against the shoulder.

cco:ont00000157.label: Facial Hair
cco:ont00000157.definition: A Bodily Component that consists of a portion of hair that grows on the face of a human (typically male) or other animal.

cco:ont00000158.label: Lithium-ion Electric Battery
cco:ont00000158.definition: A Secondary Cell Electric Battery that produces electricity when lithium ions move from anode to cathode.

cco:ont00000159.label: Material Copy of a Timekeeping Instrument
cco:ont00000159.definition: An Information Bearing Artifact that is designed to carry some specific Information Content Entity that is about some temporal region.

cco:ont00000160.label: Manual Tool
cco:ont00000160.definition: A Tool that is designed to be powered by manual labor rather than by an engine.

cco:ont00000161.label: Coordinate System Axis
cco:ont00000161.definition: A One-Dimensional Spatial Region defined by a Coordinate System for the purpose of identifying the position of entities along one dimension of the Coordinate System's spatial framework.

cco:ont00000162.label: Electrical Connector Artifact Function
cco:ont00000162.definition: An Electrical Conduction Artifact Function that is realized by processes in which some Material Artifact is used to join electrical terminations to create an electrical circuit.

cco:ont00000163.label: z-Axis
cco:ont00000163.definition: A Coordinate System Axis designated by the variable 'z'.

cco:ont00000164.label: Minimum Ordinal Measurement Information Content Entity
cco:ont00000164.definition: An Ordinal Measurement Information Content Entity that is a measurement of some entity in virtue of it being the smallest or having the least amount relative to a nominally described set of like entities.

cco:ont00000165.label: Criminal Act
cco:ont00000165.definition: A Planned Act committed in violation of rules or laws for which some governing authority (via mechanisms such as legal systems) can prescribe a conviction.

cco:ont00000166.label: Wave Cycle
cco:ont00000166.definition: A Wave Process that consists of a portion of a Wave Process that begins at an arbitrary point of the Wave Process and ends at the next point when the pattern of the Wave Process begins to repeat.

cco:ont00000167.label: Large-Scale Rocket Launcher
cco:ont00000167.definition: A Rocket Launcher that is designed to contain multiple Rocket Launchers.

cco:ont00000168.label: Act of Interpersonal Relationship
cco:ont00000168.definition: An Act of Association between two or more Persons that may range from fleeting to enduring.

cco:ont00000169.label: Very High Frequency
cco:ont00000169.definition: A Radio Frequency that is between 30 and 300 MHz.

cco:ont00000170.label: Object Track Point
cco:ont00000170.definition: A Zero-Dimensional Spatial Region that is an idealized point where an Object is or was located during some motion.

cco:ont00000171.label: Detergent Artifact Function
cco:ont00000171.definition: A Surfactant Artifact Function that is realized in a process that cleans substances in dilute solutions.

cco:ont00000172.label: Base of Operations
cco:ont00000172.definition: A Military Base with permanently stationed operating forces, robust Infrastructure, and strengthened force protection measures such that it is designed to launch and support large-scale operations, support smaller or less-permanent bases, and organize supply facilities.

cco:ont00000173.label: Civilian Role
cco:ont00000173.definition: A Role that inheres in an Agent or Group of Agents by virtue of that Agent or Group of Agents not being part of either an Armed Force or police force.

cco:ont00000174.label: Ultraviolet Telescope
cco:ont00000174.definition: A Telescope that is designed to aid in the observation of spatially distant Objects by means of collecting and focusing ultraviolet light to form an enhanced image of the Object.

cco:ont00000175.label: Organization Member Role
cco:ont00000175.definition: A Role that inheres in an Agent in virtue of the responsibilities that Agent is expected to fulfill as a member of some Organization.

cco:ont00000176.label: Geopolitical Organization
cco:ont00000176.definition: An Organization that bears a Geopolitical Power Role.

cco:ont00000177.label: Affordance
cco:ont00000177.definition: A Realizable Entity of an Independent Continuant that creates an opportunity for an Agent to realize some Agent Capability or Disposition in some Act.

cco:ont00000178.label: Arrow
cco:ont00000178.definition: A Portion of Ammunition that is designed to be fired from a Bow and consists of a long straight stiff shaft with stabilizers (fletchings) and a slot (the nock) on one end and a weighted tip (the arrowhead) on the other end.

cco:ont00000179.label: Thrust
cco:ont00000179.definition: A Force that is equal in magnitude to but in the opposite direction of an exerted Force and which is used to describe the forward Force of a Jet or Rocket Engine in reaction to the Acceleration of its Reaction Mass in the opposite direction.

cco:ont00000180.label: Hotel
cco:ont00000180.definition: A Residential Facility that is designed to provide lodging that is paid for on a short-term basis.

cco:ont00000181.label: Language Skill
cco:ont00000181.definition: A Skill that is realized by an Act which is prescribed by a Language.

cco:ont00000182.label: Act of Thanking
cco:ont00000182.definition: An Act of Expressive Communication performed by expressing gratitude.

cco:ont00000183.label: Fragrance Artifact Function
cco:ont00000183.definition: An Artifact Function that is realized in processes of emitting a pleasant or sweet odor.

cco:ont00000184.label: Axial Rotation Period
cco:ont00000184.definition: A Temporal Interval that is equal to the length of time required for a spinning Object to complete one rotation around its Axis of Rotation.

cco:ont00000185.label: Blunt
cco:ont00000185.definition: A Shape Quality inhering in a bearer in virtue of the bearer not having a sharp edge or point.

cco:ont00000186.label: Artifact Version Ordinality
cco:ont00000186.definition: An Ordinal Measurement Information Content Entity that is about the form of a Material Artifact which differs in some respects from previous or future forms of that Material Artifact.

cco:ont00000187.label: Authority Role
cco:ont00000187.definition: A Role that is realized by Processes which create, modify, transfer, or eliminate Process Regulations or other Authority Roles, and inheres in an Agent in virtue of collective acceptance of that Agent's ability to issue binding directives.

cco:ont00000188.label: Ground Track
cco:ont00000188.definition: A One-Dimensional Spatial Region defined by the line formed on the surface of an Astronomical Body by projecting an imaginary line from the center of the tracked Object to the center of the Astronomical Body as the Object travels above the surface.

cco:ont00000189.label: Material Copy of a Certificate
cco:ont00000189.definition: An Information Bearing Artifact that bears an Information Content Entity which attests to certain demonstrated characteristics of an Object, Person, or Organization.

cco:ont00000190.label: Minimum Speed Artifact Function
cco:ont00000190.definition: A Speed Artifact Function that is realized in some process in which the Material Artifact bearing the Artifact Function attains the lowest speed at which that Material Artifact is designed to operate.

cco:ont00000191.label: Act of Homicide
cco:ont00000191.definition: An Act of Violence which causes the unlawful killing of another person.

cco:ont00000192.label: Facility
cco:ont00000192.definition: A Material Artifact that is designed as a building or campus dedicated to some specific purpose.

cco:ont00000193.label: Telephone Subscriber Line
cco:ont00000193.definition: A Telephone Line that connects a Communication Endpoint to another node in a Telecommunication Network to enable service to a user's Telephone.

cco:ont00000194.label: Electrical Contact Artifact Function
cco:ont00000194.definition: An Electrical Conduction Artifact Function that is realized by processes in which some Material Artifact is used as an endpoint of an electrical circuit from which an electrical current is passed via physical contact with the endpoint.

cco:ont00000195.label: Heliport
cco:ont00000195.definition: An Airport that is designed for launching, receiving, and housing Rotorcraft.

cco:ont00000196.label: Purple
cco:ont00000196.definition: A Color that is aproximately midway between Red and Blue.

cco:ont00000197.label: Process Beginning
cco:ont00000197.definition: A Process Boundary that occupies a Zero-Dimensional Temporal Region that is the starting instant of the One-Dimensional Temporal Region that the Process, of which the Process Boundary is a part, occupies.

cco:ont00000198.label: Measurement Unit of Sound Level
cco:ont00000198.definition: A Measurement Unit that is used as a standard for measurement of the level (the loudness) of sounds.

cco:ont00000199.label: Camera
cco:ont00000199.definition: An Imaging Instrument that is designed to form and digitally or physically record an image of an entity.

cco:ont00000200.label: Act of Pilgrimage
cco:ont00000200.definition: An Act of Travel to a location of importance to a person's beliefs and faith.

cco:ont00000201.label: Act of Change of Residence
cco:ont00000201.definition: An Act of Location Change involving one or more Persons moving from one place of residence to another.

cco:ont00000202.label: Act of Terrorist Training Instruction
cco:ont00000202.definition: An Act of Training Instruction performed by an Agent who realizes a capacity derived from the Agent's affiliation with some Terrorist Organization by imparting knowledge of the tactics, techniques, and/or strategies of the use of violence against civilians in order to attain goals that are political, religous, or ideological in nature to an Agent either directly or indirectly through some communication medium.

cco:ont00000203.label: Event Status Nominal Information Content Entity
cco:ont00000203.definition: A Nominal Measurement Information Content Entity that is a measurement of the current state of a process.

cco:ont00000204.label: Rifle
cco:ont00000204.definition: A Long Gun that is designed to have a rifled barrel and to fire single Bullets over long ranges with high accuracy.

cco:ont00000205.label: Object Track
cco:ont00000205.definition: A One-Dimensional Spatial Region that consists of the idealized line along which an Object has traversed during some motion.

cco:ont00000206.label: Friction Reduction Artifact Function
cco:ont00000206.definition: An Artifact Function that is realized in processes of reducing the force resisting the relative motion of surfaces in contact.

cco:ont00000207.label: One-Dimensional Geospatial Boundary
cco:ont00000207.definition: A Fiat Line that is a boundary of some Geospatial Region.

cco:ont00000208.label: Act of Congratulating
cco:ont00000208.definition: An Act of Expressive Communication performed by expressing vicarious pleasure to a person on the occasion of their success or good fortune.

cco:ont00000209.label: Sound Wavelength
cco:ont00000209.definition: A Wavelength that is the distance a Sound Wave traverses during one Wave Cycle.

cco:ont00000210.label: Engine
cco:ont00000210.definition: A Material Artifact that is designed to convert one form of energy into mechanical energy.

cco:ont00000211.label: Multi-Day Temporal Interval
cco:ont00000211.definition: A one-dimensional temporal region that is measured in Days and spans at least one Day.

cco:ont00000212.label: Chemical Weapon
cco:ont00000212.definition: A Weapon that is designed to inflict harm, damage, or incapacity by means of releasing toxic chemicals.

cco:ont00000213.label: Subcontinent
cco:ont00000213.definition: A Geospatial Region that is bounded by a large, relatively self-contained landmass forming a subdivision of a Continent.

cco:ont00000214.label: Moving Target Indication Artifact Function
cco:ont00000214.definition: A Radar Imaging Artifact Function that inheres in Material Artifacts that are designed to identify and produce visual representations of moving entities by using a radar to emit successive phase coherent pulses, which are sampled and added to the subsequent pulse to cancel out signals from non-moving entities such that only signals from moving entities remain and are displayed.

cco:ont00000215.label: Radio Telescope
cco:ont00000215.definition: A Telescope that is designed to aid in the observation of spatially distant Objects by means of collecting and focusing radio waves to form an enhanced image of the Object.

cco:ont00000216.label: Shell
cco:ont00000216.definition: A Portion of Ammunition that is designed to be a non-self-propelled projectile and to carry a payload (explosive or other) over a relatively short distance.

cco:ont00000217.label: Measurement Unit of Area
cco:ont00000217.definition: A Measurement Unit that is used as a standard for measurement of two-dimensional regions or Geospatial Regions.

cco:ont00000218.label: Major Axis
cco:ont00000218.definition: A One-Dimensional Spatial Region that is the longest line segment that connects two points on the edge of an Ellipse.

cco:ont00000219.label: Reflecting Optical Telescope
cco:ont00000219.definition: An Optical Telescope that is designed to aid in the observation of spatially distant Objects by means of collecting and focusing visible light via reflection through the use of one or more curved Mirrors to form an enhanced image of the Object.

cco:ont00000220.label: Ammunition Depot
cco:ont00000220.definition: A Storage Facility that is designed to store Portions of Ammunition.

cco:ont00000221.label: Semi-Minor Axis
cco:ont00000221.definition: A One-Dimensional Spatial Region that is equal to half the length of the Minor Axis of an Ellipse.

cco:ont00000222.label: Presence Frequency
cco:ont00000222.definition: A Sonic Frequency that is between 4 and 6 kHz.

cco:ont00000223.label: Time of Day
cco:ont00000223.definition: A Temporal Instant that is part of a Day.

cco:ont00000224.label: Populated place
cco:ont00000224.definition: An Anthropogenic Feature at which people live or have lived.

cco:ont00000225.label: Month
cco:ont00000225.definition: A Temporal Interval that is based on the approximate length of time required for a Natural Satellite to complete one cycle of its rotational motion around its Primary Body.

cco:ont00000226.label: Transportation Facility
cco:ont00000226.definition: A Facility that is designed for commencing or concluding the transportation of transportation artifacts, or for housing transportation artifacts.

cco:ont00000227.label: Julian Year
cco:ont00000227.definition: A Calendar Year in the Julian Calendar.

cco:ont00000228.label: Planned Act
cco:ont00000228.definition: An Act in which at least one Agent plays a causative role and which is prescribed by some Directive Information Content Entity held by at least one of the Agents.

cco:ont00000229.label: Measurement Unit of Power
cco:ont00000229.definition: A Measurement Unit that is used as a standard for measurement of rates of work.

cco:ont00000230.label: Diffraction Grating
cco:ont00000230.definition: An Optical Instrument with a periodic structure that is designed to split and defract a beam of light into several beams travelling in different directions.

cco:ont00000231.label: Torpedo Tube
cco:ont00000231.definition: A Projectile Launcher that is designed to launch Torpedoes.

cco:ont00000232.label: Pumping Station
cco:ont00000232.definition: A Product Transport Facility that is designed to pump fluids from one place to another.

cco:ont00000233.label: Stock Certificate
cco:ont00000233.definition: Stock that consists of a Certificate.

cco:ont00000234.label: Act of Training
cco:ont00000234.definition: A Planned Act in which knowledge, skills or values are imparted from one or more Agents to at least one other Agent.

cco:ont00000235.label: Act of Vocational Training Acquisition
cco:ont00000235.definition: An Act of Training Acquisition performed by an Agent by acquiring skills required for a specific occupation in industry, agriculture or trade from an Agent or communication medium that realizes a capacity derived from its affiliation with a Vocational School, Technical School, Trade Organization, or Industry Educational Program Provider.

cco:ont00000236.label: Lighting System
cco:ont00000236.definition: A Material Artifact that is designed to emit light within some area.

cco:ont00000237.label: Act of Terrorist Training Acquisition
cco:ont00000237.definition: An Act of Training Acquisition performed by an Agent by acquiring knowledge of the tactics, techniques, and/or strategies of the use of violence against civilians in order to attain goals that are political, religous, or ideological in nature from an Agent or communication medium that realizes a capacity derived from its affiliation with a Terrorist Organization.

cco:ont00000238.label: Propeller
cco:ont00000238.definition: A Material Artifact that is designed to convert rotary motion from an Engine or other mechanical Power Source into propulsive Force.

cco:ont00000239.label: Measurement Unit of Mass
cco:ont00000239.definition: A Measurement Unit that is used as a standard for measurement of an object's resistance to Acceleration when a Force is applied to the object.

cco:ont00000240.label: Act of Oath Taking
cco:ont00000240.definition: An Act of Commissive Communication performed by stating or promising, usually calling upon something or someone that the oath maker considers sacred.

cco:ont00000243.label: Heat Sink
cco:ont00000243.definition: A Material Artifact that is designed to regulate the temperature of a computer by the passive transfer of heat away from other components in the computer.

cco:ont00000244.label: Fragmentation Artifact Function
cco:ont00000244.definition: A Damaging Artifact Function that is realized in a process in which the structural integrity of an entity is impaired because of a detonation which causes fragmentation.

cco:ont00000245.label: Petroleum Manufacturing Facility
cco:ont00000245.definition: A Factory that is designed to manufacture petroleum-based products.

cco:ont00000246.label: Stasis of Realizable Entity
cco:ont00000246.definition: A Stasis of Specifically Dependent Continuant in which some Independent Continuant bears some Realizable Entity that remains unchanged during a Temporal Interval.

cco:ont00000247.label: Road
cco:ont00000247.definition: A Land Transportation Artifact that is designed to enable Ground Vehicles to travel from one location to another.

cco:ont00000248.label: Chemical Manufacturing Facility
cco:ont00000248.definition: A Factory that is designed to manufacture or process chemicals.

cco:ont00000249.label: Shaft
cco:ont00000249.definition: A Material Artifact that is designed to rotate and transmit Torque, Power, or Rotational Motion from one machine element to another.

cco:ont00000250.label: Loss of Realizable Entity
cco:ont00000250.definition: A Loss of Specifically Dependent Continuant in which some Independent Continuant ceases to be the bearer of some Realizable Entity.

cco:ont00000251.label: Continent
cco:ont00000251.definition: A Geospatial Region that is bounded by any of the Earth's main continuous expanses of land.

cco:ont00000252.label: Nozzle
cco:ont00000252.definition: A Fluid Control Artifact that is designed to control the speed, direction, rate, shape, or pressure of the flow of fluid exiting it.

cco:ont00000253.label: Information Bearing Entity
cco:ont00000253.definition: An Object upon which an Information Content Entity generically depends.

cco:ont00000254.label: Transportation Artifact
cco:ont00000254.definition: A Material Artifact that is fixed in place and designed to enable the movement of Vehicles and Agents from one location to another.

cco:ont00000255.label: Portion of Cryogenic Material
cco:ont00000255.definition: A Portion of Material that has been reduced to a very low temperature (below -180 degrees Celcius).

cco:ont00000256.label: Fluid Control Artifact
cco:ont00000256.definition: A Material Artifact that is designed to manipulate the flow of a fluid (i.e. a liquid or a gas).

cco:ont00000257.label: Radiopaque
cco:ont00000257.definition: A Radiopacity that inheres in a bearer in virtue of its capacity to prevent most X-rays from passing through it.

cco:ont00000259.label: Calendar Month
cco:ont00000259.definition: A Month that begins and ends concurrently with the Days specified by a Calendar System to be the first and last Days of the Month.

cco:ont00000260.label: Muzzle Blast
cco:ont00000260.definition: A Sound Wave Process that is caused by a projectile being pushed from the barrel of a firearm by an explosive charge.

cco:ont00000261.label: Gamma Ray Frequency
cco:ont00000261.definition: An Electromagnetic Radiation Frequency of some Electromagnetic Wave that is above 30 exahertz.

cco:ont00000262.label: Shop
cco:ont00000262.definition: A Commercial Facility designed to sell small lots of goods to consumers.

cco:ont00000263.label: Clock Time System
cco:ont00000263.definition: A Temporal Reference System that is a convention for keeping and displaying the Time of Day.

cco:ont00000264.label: Hydraulic Fluid Reservoir
cco:ont00000264.definition: A Container that is designed to store some hydraulic fluid for use in some Hyrdraulic Power Source.

cco:ont00000265.label: Election
cco:ont00000265.definition: A Social Act by which a population chooses an individual to hold public office.

cco:ont00000266.label: Hearing Aid
cco:ont00000266.definition: A Medical Artifact that is designed to improve hearing for its user.

cco:ont00000267.label: Catalyst Artifact Function
cco:ont00000267.definition: A Chemical Reaction Artifact Function that is realized in a process in which the rate of a chemical reaction is increased due to the participation of an additional substance, without that substance being consumed in the reaction.

cco:ont00000268.label: Cannon
cco:ont00000268.definition: A Projectile Launcher that is designed to use a controlled explosion to launch a relatively large Portion of Ammunition, such as a Round Shot or a Shell, at a significant Velocity.

cco:ont00000269.label: Radio Transmitter
cco:ont00000269.definition: A Radio Communication Instrument that is an electronic device that is designed to generate a radio frequency alternating current, which can be applied to a Radio Antenna to be transmitted as radio waves.

cco:ont00000270.label: Educational Facility
cco:ont00000270.definition: A Facility that is designed for facilitating learning, or the acquisition of knowledge, skills, values, beliefs, and habits.

cco:ont00000271.label: Underground Mine
cco:ont00000271.definition: A Mine that is designed to support the extraction of materials from the ground using underground tunnels and shafts.

cco:ont00000272.label: Combustion
cco:ont00000272.definition: A Natural Process in which a Portion of Fuel or other Material Entity is burned.

cco:ont00000273.label: Communication Interference Artifact Function
cco:ont00000273.definition: An Artifact Function that is realized during events in which a Material Artifact is used to interfere with the transmission of information for the purpose of preventing communication.

cco:ont00000274.label: Armed Force
cco:ont00000274.definition: An Organization having the Objective to further the foreign and domestic policies of a Government and to defend that body and the nation it represents from external and internal aggressors.

cco:ont00000275.label: Spatial Reference System
cco:ont00000275.definition: A Reference System that describes a set of standards for uniquely identifying the position of an entity or the direction of a vector within a defined spatial region by means of measurements along one or more Coordinate System Axes.

cco:ont00000276.label: Solar Calendar System
cco:ont00000276.definition: A Calendar System that is designed to organize and identify dates based on the cycles of an Astronomical Body's Orbit around the Sun.

cco:ont00000277.label: Nuclear Weapon
cco:ont00000277.definition: A Weapon that is designed to inflict harm, damage, or incapacity by means of a destructive nuclear reaction, either through fission or through a combination of fission and fusion.

cco:ont00000278.label: Momentum
cco:ont00000278.definition: A Process Profile of an object in Motion that is the product of its Mass and Velocity with respect to a frame of reference.

cco:ont00000279.label: Enemy Role
cco:ont00000279.definition: An Allegiance Role that inheres in an Agent by virtue of that Agent having committed offensive Acts or exhibited intent to perform such Acts towards a particular Agent or Group of Agents or has been declared as hostile by some appropriate authority.

cco:ont00000280.label: Torpedo
cco:ont00000280.definition: A Precision-Guided Missile that is designed to be fired into a body of water, be self-propelled through the water, and carry an explosive payload.

cco:ont00000281.label: Albedo
cco:ont00000281.definition: A Radiation Reflectivity that inheres in a bearer in virtue of the capacity of its surface to reflect incident electromagnetic radiation of a particular wavelength.

cco:ont00000282.label: Counterfeit Financial Instrument
cco:ont00000282.definition: A Counterfeit Instrument that is designed to be a fake replica of some legally sanctioned Financial Instrument.

cco:ont00000283.label: Cylindrical
cco:ont00000283.definition: A Three Dimensional Shape inhering in a bearer in virtue of the bearer having an elongated shape with round bases.

cco:ont00000284.label: Strength
cco:ont00000284.definition: A Realizable Entity that is realized when its bearer exerts or resists some power, influence, or force.

cco:ont00000285.label: Emergency Locator Transmitter
cco:ont00000285.definition: A Radio Transmitter that is designed to signal distress and provide positional data for the entity it is located on.

cco:ont00000286.label: Stasis of Partially Mission Capable Maintenance
cco:ont00000286.definition: A Stasis of Partially Mission Capable during which the participating Continuant is not capable of performing some of its primary functions for the specified Mission due to participating in an Act Of Maintenance.

cco:ont00000287.label: Inertial Navigation System
cco:ont00000287.definition: A Navigation System that is designed to continuously calculate via dead reckoning the position, orientation, and velocity of a moving object without the need for external references.

cco:ont00000288.label: Power Source
cco:ont00000288.definition: A Material Artifact that is designed to supply power to some other Material Artifact.

cco:ont00000289.label: Radar Imaging Artifact Function

cco:ont00000460.definition: A Government Domain that delimits a local Government.

cco:ont00000462.label: Gain of Function
cco:ont00000462.definition: A Gain of Disposition in which some Independent Continuant becomes the bearer of some Function.

cco:ont00000463.label: Act of Educational Training Instruction
cco:ont00000463.definition: An Act of Training Instruction performed by an Agent who realizes a capacity derived from the Agent's affiliation with some Educational Organization by imparting knowledge of a curriculum to an Agent either directly or indirectly through some communication medium.

cco:ont00000464.label: Oblong
cco:ont00000464.definition: A Shape Quality inhering in a bearer in virtue of the bearer having an long thin shape with approximately parallel sides.

cco:ont00000465.label: Modified Julian Date
cco:ont00000465.definition: A Time of Day as specified according to the Julian Calendar using the Modified Julian Date epoch.

cco:ont00000466.label: Orientation Control Artifact Function
cco:ont00000466.definition: An Artifact Function that is realized by processes in which some Material Artifact is used to control the Orientation of some object.

cco:ont00000467.label: Armored Personnel Carrier
cco:ont00000467.definition: An Armored Fighting Vehicle that is designed to transport infantry to the battlefield but which are not usually designed to take part in a direct-fire battle.

cco:ont00000468.label: Office Building
cco:ont00000468.definition: A Commercial Facility that is designed as an environment for conducting commercial, professional, or bureaucratic work.

cco:ont00000469.label: Geospatial Coordinate Reference System
cco:ont00000469.definition: A Spatial Reference System that is used to determine and identify the location of a point or object at or near the surface of the Earth.

cco:ont00000470.label: Material Copy of a Academic Degree
cco:ont00000470.definition: A Material Copy of a Certificate that is issued by an Educational Organization to a Person to indicate that the Person has satisfactorily completed a course of study, or as an honorary recognition of the Person's achievement.

cco:ont00000471.label: Material Copy of a Warning Message
cco:ont00000471.definition: A Material Copy of a Notification Message that is designed to carry an Information Content Entity that describes a possible or impending threat.

cco:ont00000472.label: Geospatial Region
cco:ont00000472.definition: A Site that is at or near the surface of the Earth.

cco:ont00000473.label: Fourth-Order Administrative Region
cco:ont00000473.definition: A Government Domain that is a subdivision of a Third-Order Administrative Region.

cco:ont00000474.label: Curved
cco:ont00000474.definition: A Shape Quality inhering in a bearer in virtue of the bearer having borders which are smoothly rounded.

cco:ont00000475.label: Portion of Cash
cco:ont00000475.definition: A Financial Instrument that is designed to be a ready medium of exchange.

cco:ont00000476.label: Objective
cco:ont00000476.definition: A Prescriptive Information Content Entity that prescribes some projected state that some Agent intends to achieve.

cco:ont00000477.label: Fuel Cell
cco:ont00000477.definition: An Electrical Power Source that consists in part of an anode, a cathode, and an electrolyte; converts chemical energy from a fuel into electricity through a chemical reaction of positively charged hydrogen ions with an oxidizing agent (typically oxygen); and, if given a continuous source of fuel and oxidizing agent, can continuously produce electricity.

cco:ont00000478.label: Cuboidal
cco:ont00000478.definition: A Three Dimensional Shape that inheres in a bearer in virtue of it having six Rectangular faces.

cco:ont00000479.label: Public Safety Facility
cco:ont00000479.definition: A Facility that is designed for the prevention of and protection from events that could endanger, injure, or damage the general public.

cco:ont00000480.label: Life Support Artifact Function
cco:ont00000480.definition: An Artifact Function that is realized during events in which a Material Artifact materially affects an organism, where this causes that organism to continue living in a situation where death would otherwise occur.

cco:ont00000481.label: Research and Development Artifact Function
cco:ont00000481.definition: A Service Artifact Function that is realized in processes of producing new knowledge or of devising new applications of existing knowledge.

cco:ont00000482.label: Synthetic Aperture Radar Imaging Artifact Function
cco:ont00000482.definition: A Radar Imaging Artifact Function that inheres in Material Artifacts that are designed to produce visual representations of entities using the motion of a radar antenna over a targeted region to create a synthetic aperture.

cco:ont00000483.label: Military Base
cco:ont00000483.definition: A Military Facility that is designed to shelter military equipment and personnel and to facilitate training and operations.

cco:ont00000484.label: Concave Shape
cco:ont00000484.definition: A Shape Quality that inheres in a bearer in virtue of the bearer having one or more cavities, such that at least one line connecting a pair of points on the surface of the bearer will lie outside.

cco:ont00000485.label: Commercial Role
cco:ont00000485.definition: A Role that inheres in an Organization by virtue of its establishment as a for-profit business.

cco:ont00000486.label: Neutral Role
cco:ont00000486.definition: An Allegiance Role that inheres in an Agent by virtue of that Agent not performing or being committed to performing Acts that have as their Objective to either support or undermine the Objectives of an Agent or Group of Agents involved in some conflict.

cco:ont00000487.label: Geospatial Location
cco:ont00000487.definition: A Geospatial Region that is the location of an Independent Continuant (that is not a Spatial Region) or that environs some Process.

cco:ont00000488.label: Tripod
cco:ont00000488.definition: A Material Artifact that consists of three legs and a platform that joins them and which is designed to support the weight and maintain the stability of objects that are attached to or rested on the platform.

cco:ont00000489.label: High Density Residential Area
cco:ont00000489.definition: A Populated Place which is characterized by densely contained multiple-unit living structures.

cco:ont00000490.label: X-ray Frequency
cco:ont00000490.definition: An Electromagnetic Radiation Frequency of some Electromagnetic Wave that is between 30 petahertz and 30 exahertz.

cco:ont00000491.label: Detonating Artifact Function
cco:ont00000491.definition: An Artifact Function that is realized in processes of combustion involving a supersonic exothermic front accelerating through a medium that eventually drives a shock front propagating directly in front of it.

cco:ont00000492.label: Email Messaging
cco:ont00000492.definition: An Act of Communication Mediated by Artifact in which digital messages are transmitted and received via Internet Message Format-based communication, or an extension thereof, over a computer network.

cco:ont00000493.label: Material Copy of a Code List
cco:ont00000493.definition: A Material Copy of a List that contains an ordered sequence of Information Bearing Entities that carry Code Identifiers.

cco:ont00000494.label: Serrated
cco:ont00000494.definition: A Shape Quality inhering in a bearer in virtue of the bearer having multiple sharp points along a edge.

cco:ont00000495.label: Radio Communication Interference Artifact Function
cco:ont00000495.definition: A Communication Interference Artifact Function that is realized during events in which a Material Artifact is used to interfere with the transmission of information via radio waves.

cco:ont00000496.label: Natural Language
cco:ont00000496.definition: A Language that is developed and evolves through use and repetition, rather than through conscious planning or premeditation.

cco:ont00000497.label: Measurement Unit of Force
cco:ont00000497.definition: A Measurement Unit that is used as a standard for measurement of interactions in which the Motion or Velocity of an object is changed, unless the interaction is opposed.

cco:ont00000498.label: Julian Day
cco:ont00000498.definition: A Calendar Day in the Julian Calendar.

cco:ont00000499.label: Wire Antenna
cco:ont00000499.definition: A Radio Antenna that consists primarily of a length of wire.

cco:ont00000500.label: Eye
cco:ont00000500.definition: A Bodily Component that consists of an organ that canonically affords the Agent it is part of with the ability to receive visual stimuli necessary for sight.

cco:ont00000501.label: Act of Financial Withdrawal
cco:ont00000501.definition: An Act of Financial Instrument Use wherein a Financial Instrument is transferred by an Agent to another Agent (the Depositor) from an account created by an earlier Act of Financial Deposit performed by the Depositor.

cco:ont00000502.label: Measurement Unit of Area Moment of Inertia
cco:ont00000502.definition: A Measurement Unit that is used as a standard for measurement of the distribution of Mass of an object with respect to an axis.

cco:ont00000503.label: Power
cco:ont00000503.definition: A Process Profile that is characterized by the rate of Work, or Energy consumed, done in a given time period.

cco:ont00000504.label: Optical Processing Artifact Function
cco:ont00000504.definition: An Artifact Function that is realized by a Material Artifact participating in a visible light processing event.

cco:ont00000506.label: Contractor Role
cco:ont00000506.definition: A Role that inheres in an Agent or Group of Agents by virtue of that Agent or Group of Agents entering into a Contract to provide materials or labor to perform a service or complete a task.

cco:ont00000507.label: Ethnic Group
cco:ont00000507.definition: A Group of Persons who identify with one another based on one or more shared inherited characteristics such as language, ancestry, nationality, culture, customs, religion, or social experiences.

cco:ont00000508.label: Near Ultraviolet Light Frequency
cco:ont00000508.definition: An Ultraviolet Light Frequency that is between 750 terahertz and 3 petahertz.

cco:ont00000509.label: Service Provider
cco:ont00000509.definition: An Organization whose purpose is to provide a service to other Agents.

cco:ont00000510.label: Mosque
cco:ont00000510.definition: A Religious Facility that is designed for Islamic worship and prayer.

cco:ont00000511.label: Act of Planning
cco:ont00000511.definition: A Planned Act that involves making a Plan to achieve some specified Objective.

cco:ont00000512.label: Radiation Emissivity
cco:ont00000512.definition: A Disposition to Interact with Electromagnetic Radiation that inheres in a bearer in virtue of the capacity of that bearer to emit electromagnetic radiation of a given frequency.

cco:ont00000513.label: Act of Tool Use
cco:ont00000513.definition: An Act of Artifact Employment in which some Agent uses some Tool.

cco:ont00000514.label: Transverse Wave Profile
cco:ont00000514.definition: A Wave Process Profile in which the displacement of participating particles is perpendicular to the direction of the Wave Process' propogation.

cco:ont00000515.label: Act of Vehicle Use
cco:ont00000515.definition: An Act of Artifact Employment in which some Agent uses some Vehicle.

cco:ont00000516.label: Pneumatic Power Source
cco:ont00000516.definition: A Power Source that is designed to generate, control, or transmit power by means of compressed air or compressed inert gases.

cco:ont00000517.label: Act of Communication by Movement of Information Bearing Artifact
cco:ont00000517.definition: An Act of Communication in which some Material Artifact is used to transfer an Information Bearing Entity from sender(s) to receiver(s).

cco:ont00000518.label: Measurement Unit of Currency
cco:ont00000518.definition: A Measurement Unit used in measurements of financial values.

cco:ont00000519.label: Extremely High Frequency
cco:ont00000519.definition: A Microwave Frequency that is between 30 and 300 GHz.

cco:ont00000520.label: Act of Departure
cco:ont00000520.definition: An Act of Location Change that consists of the participating entity leaving its starting location such that the larger Act of Location Change is initiated.

cco:ont00000521.label: Act of Assassination
cco:ont00000521.definition: An Act of Murder of a prominent person.

cco:ont00000522.label: Pulsejet Engine
cco:ont00000522.definition: An Air-Breathing Jet Engine that is capable of operating statically and uses intermittent (pulsing) Combustion of the fuel-oxidizer mixture before expelling the exhaust out through the rear Propelling Nozzle to generate Thrust.

cco:ont00000523.label: Loudness
cco:ont00000523.definition: A Sound Process Profile that is characterized by the amplitude and total energy of translated sound waves, typically on a continuum from soft to loud.

cco:ont00000524.label: Air Conditioning Unit
