cco:ont00000924.label: Beginning of Life Stasis
cco:ont00000924.definition: A Operational Stasis that holds during a Temporal Interval when a Material Artifact is first put into operational use such that its designed set of Artifact Functions is capable of operating at or near their designed peak performance levels.

cco:ont00000925.label: Act of Military Training Acquisition
cco:ont00000925.definition: An Act of Training Acquisition performed by an Agent by acquiring knowledge of the tactics, techniques, and/or strategies of Military Operations from an Agent or communication medium that realizes a capacity derived from its affiliation with a Military Organization.

cco:ont00000926.label: Act of Apologizing
cco:ont00000926.definition: An Act of Expressive Communication performed by acknowledging and expressing regret for a fault, shortcoming, or failure.

cco:ont00000927.label: Bass Frequency
cco:ont00000927.definition: A Sonic Frequency that is between 60 and 250 Hz.

cco:ont00000928.label: Train Car
cco:ont00000928.definition: A Rail Transport Vehicle that consists of a single Vehicle that is not a Train but is designed to be connected to other Train Cars along with at least one Locomotive to form a Train.

cco:ont00000929.label: Part Role
cco:ont00000929.definition: A Role that inheres in an entity in virtue of it being part of some other entity without being subject to further subdivision or disassembly without destruction of its designated use.

cco:ont00000930.label: Nickel-metal Hydride Electric Battery
cco:ont00000930.definition: A Secondary Cell Electric Battery that has a metal-hydride anode and nickel oxide hydroxide cathode.

cco:ont00000932.label: Computing Artifact Function
cco:ont00000932.definition: An Artifact Function that is realized by a Material Artifact participating in a computation process.

cco:ont00000933.label: Landline Telephone
cco:ont00000933.definition: A Telephone that is connected to a Telephone Network through a pair of wires.

cco:ont00000934.label: Constituent State
cco:ont00000934.definition: A First-Order Administrative Region that is part of a Country and delimits a centralized regional Government that holds constitutionally-defined administrative jurisdiction over the defined geographic territory that bounds the State.

cco:ont00000935.label: Act of Legal Instrument Use
cco:ont00000935.definition: An Act of Artifact Employment in which some Agent uses some Legal Instrument.

cco:ont00000936.label: Deactivated Stasis
cco:ont00000936.definition: A Stasis of Artifact Operationality that holds during a Temporal Interval when a Material Artifact is not realizing any of its designed Artifact Functions (or at least not realizing any of its primary functions).

cco:ont00000937.label: Inhibiting Motion Artifact Function
cco:ont00000937.definition: An Artifact Function that is realized by processes in which some Material Artifact is used to inhibit the motion of some object.

cco:ont00000938.label: Financial Artifact Function
cco:ont00000938.definition: A Service Artifact Function that is realized in processes of managing money.

cco:ont00000939.label: Geospatial Line
cco:ont00000939.definition: A Geospatial Line String that has only two vertices.

cco:ont00000940.label: Measurement Unit of Momentum
cco:ont00000940.definition: A Measurement Unit that is used as a standard for measurement of the Momentum of a portion of matter that is in Motion.

cco:ont00000941.label: Phosphorescence
cco:ont00000941.definition: A Luminescent Property that inheres in a bearer in virtue of that bearer's capacity to emit visible light after absorbing shorter wavelength radiation, and to continue emitting after the absorbing process has ceased.

cco:ont00000942.label: Sniper Rifle
cco:ont00000942.definition: A Rifle that is designed to be highly accurate for long-range precision tactical shooting.

cco:ont00000943.label: Ocular Prosthesis
cco:ont00000943.definition: An Artificial Eye that is designed to replace a missing eye, but which does not function as an eye.

cco:ont00000944.label: Thermal Imaging Artifact Function
cco:ont00000944.definition: An Imaging Artifact Function that is realized during events in which a Material Artifact is used to create a visual representation of an entity using radiation from the far infrared region of the electromagnetic spectrum that the entity emits

cco:ont00000945.label: X-ray Telescope
cco:ont00000945.definition: A Telescope that is designed to aid in the observation of spatially distant Objects by means of collecting and focusing X-rays to form an enhanced image of the Object.

cco:ont00000946.label: Government Building
cco:ont00000946.definition: A Facility that is designed for the administration of a community.

cco:ont00000947.label: Temperature Measurement Artifact Function
cco:ont00000947.definition: A Measurement Artifact Function that is realized during events in which a Material Artifact is used to measure the Temperature of a specified object or class of objects.

cco:ont00000948.label: Act of Religious Worship
cco:ont00000948.definition: An Act of Ceremony wherein there occurs acts of religious devotion usually directed towards a deity.

cco:ont00000949.label: Act of Consumption
cco:ont00000949.definition: A Planned Act in which a resource is ingested or used up.

cco:ont00000950.label: Act of Maintenance
cco:ont00000950.definition: An Act of Artifact Modification in which a Material Artifact is modified in order to preserve or restore one or more of its designed Qualities or Functions.

cco:ont00000951.label: Electromagnetic Wave Process
cco:ont00000951.definition: A Wave Process that is produced by charged particles, involves the periodic Oscillation of electric and magnetic fields at right angles to each other and the direction of wave propogation such that it has a Transverse Wave Profile, and which transfers electromagnetic radiant energy through a portion of space or matter.

cco:ont00000952.label: Electric Motor
cco:ont00000952.definition: An Engine that is designed to convert electrical energy into mechanical energy.

cco:ont00000953.label: Pitch
cco:ont00000953.definition: A Sound Process Profile that is characterized by the frequency of translated sound waves, typically on a continuum from low to high.

cco:ont00000954.label: Telecommunication Infrastructure
cco:ont00000954.definition: An Infrastructure System that is designed to support the use of Telecommunication Instruments to communicate.

cco:ont00000955.label: Angular Momentum
cco:ont00000955.definition: A Momentum that is the product of an object's moment of inertia and its Angular Velocity.

cco:ont00000956.label: Highway Interchange
cco:ont00000956.definition: A Road Junction that is designed to enable Ground Vehicles to exit one or more Highways and enter another Highway without directly crossing any other traffic stream.

cco:ont00000957.label: Reservoir
cco:ont00000957.definition: A Storage Facility that is designed to store water in a man-made open enclosure or area.

cco:ont00000958.label: Information Content Entity
cco:ont00000958.definition: A Generically Dependent Continuant that generically depends on some Information Bearing Entity and stands in relation of aboutness to some Entity.

cco:ont00000959.label: Measurement Unit of Frequency
cco:ont00000959.definition: A Measurement Unit that is used as a standard for measurement of the number of times an event repeats per unit of time.

cco:ont00000960.label: Fixed Line Network Telephone Call
cco:ont00000960.definition: A Telephone Call transmitted over a telephone network where the telephones are wired into a single telephone exchange.

cco:ont00000961.label: Current Conversion Artifact Function
cco:ont00000961.definition: An Electrical Artifact Function that is realized by processes in which some Material Artifact is used to convert some electrical current.

cco:ont00000962.label: Portion of Liquid Propellant
cco:ont00000962.definition: A Portion of Propellant that is stored in a liquid state.

cco:ont00000963.label: Fuel Transfer System
cco:ont00000963.definition: A Fluid Control Artifact that is designed to facilitate the transfer of some Portion of Fuel from the Fuel Tank for use in some Engine.

cco:ont00000964.label: Medium Frequency
cco:ont00000964.definition: A Radio Frequency that is between 300 kHz and 3 MHz.

cco:ont00000965.label: Prescriptive Information Content Entity
cco:ont00000965.definition: An Information Content Entity that prescribes some Entity.

cco:ont00000967.label: Height
cco:ont00000967.definition: A One Dimensional Extent that inheres in a bearer in virtue of the bearer's extension in a vertical direction.

cco:ont00000968.label: Assault Rifle
cco:ont00000968.definition: A Rifle that is designed to have selective-fire functionality and use an intermediate Cartridge and a detachable magazine.

cco:ont00000969.label: Measurement Unit of Speed
cco:ont00000969.definition: A Measurement Unit that is used as a standard for measurement of the rates at which objects traverse distance.

cco:ont00000970.label: Act of Artifact Modification
cco:ont00000970.definition: An Act of Material Artifact Processing in which an existing Material Artifact is acted upon in a manner that changes, adds, or removes one or more of its Qualities, Dispositions, or Functions.

cco:ont00000971.label: Act of Deceptive Communication
cco:ont00000971.definition: Ac Act of Communication intended to mislead the audience by distortion or falsification of evidence and induce a reaction that is prejudicial to the interests of the audience.

cco:ont00000973.label: Decimal Time of Day Identifier
cco:ont00000973.definition: A Time of Day Identifier that designates an approximate Temporal Instant that is part of some Day and is specified using a decimal value for the portion of the Day that preceded the Temporal Instant.

cco:ont00000974.label: Plan
cco:ont00000974.definition: A Prescriptive Information Content Entity that prescribes some set of intended Intentional Acts through which some Agent expects to achieve some Objective.

cco:ont00000975.label: Cyan
cco:ont00000975.definition: A Color that is between Green and Blue with a wavelength in the visible spectrum typically between 490 and 520 nanometers.

cco:ont00000976.label: Political Orientation
cco:ont00000976.definition: An Ideology that characterizes the political thinking of an Agent or Group of Agents, usually with respect to the political environment within a particular nation.

cco:ont00000977.label: Act of Publishing Mass Media Documentary
cco:ont00000977.definition: An Act of Publishing a factual record or report.

cco:ont00000978.label: Cause
cco:ont00000978.definition: A Process that is the cause of or one of the causes of some other Process.

cco:ont00000979.label: Closure
cco:ont00000979.definition: A Quality that inheres in a bearer in virtue of the degree to which that bearer affords passage or sightline through it via an opening, aperture, orifice, or vent.

cco:ont00000980.label: Portion of Waste Material
cco:ont00000980.definition: A Portion of Processed Material that serves no further use in terms of the initial user's own purposes of production, transformation, or consumption such that the Agent wants to dispose of it.

cco:ont00000981.label: Act of Portion of Material Consumption
cco:ont00000981.definition: An Act of Artifact Employment in which a Portion of Material is expended.

cco:ont00000982.label: Decrease of Function
cco:ont00000982.definition: A Decrease of Disposition in which some Independent Continuant has a decrease of some Function that it bears.

cco:ont00000983.label: Shear Wave Process
cco:ont00000983.definition: A Mechanical Wave that has a Transverse Wave Profile.

cco:ont00000984.label: Occupation Role
cco:ont00000984.definition: A Role that inheres in an Agent in virtue of the responsibilities that Agent is expected to fulfill within the context of some Act of Employment.

cco:ont00000985.label: Thermal Insulation Artifact Function
cco:ont00000985.definition: A Thermal Control Artifact Function that is realized during events in which a Material Artifact prevents or reduces the transfer of heat between objects that are in thermal contact or in range of radiative influence.

cco:ont00000986.label: Scar
cco:ont00000986.definition: A Bodily Component that consists of a portion of fibrous connective tissue on skin or within body tissue and which was formed due to an injury that has not healed completely.

cco:ont00000987.label: Citizen Role
cco:ont00000987.definition: A Role that inheres in a Person by virtue of that Person being legally recognized as a member of a particular state, with associated rights and obligations.

cco:ont00000988.label: Reflective Prism
cco:ont00000988.definition: A Prism designed to reflect light in order to flip, invert, rotate, deviate, or displace a beam of light entering the Prism.

cco:ont00000989.label: Super High Frequency
cco:ont00000989.definition: A Microwave Frequency that is between 3 and 30 GHz.

cco:ont00000990.label: Nickname
cco:ont00000990.definition: A Designative Name that is a familiar or humorous substitute for an entity's Proper Name.

cco:ont00000991.label: Bent
cco:ont00000991.definition: A Shape Quality inhering in a bearer in virtue of the bearer having one or more angles along its border.

cco:ont00000992.label: Second
cco:ont00000992.definition: A Temporal Interval that is equal to the duration of 9,192,631,770 periods of the radiation corresponding to the transition between the two hyperfine levels of the ground state of the cesium 133 atom.

cco:ont00000993.label: Power Rectifying Artifact Function
cco:ont00000993.definition: A Current Conversion Artifact Function that is realized by processes in which some Material Artifact is used to convert alternating current (AC) to direct current (DC).

cco:ont00000994.label: Electrical Power Production Artifact Function
cco:ont00000994.definition: An Electrical Artifact Function that is realized during events in which a Material Artifact is used to generate electrical power.

cco:ont00000995.label: Material Artifact
cco:ont00000995.definition: A Material Entity that was designed by some Agent to realize a certain Function.

cco:ont00000996.label: Ramjet Engine
cco:ont00000996.definition: An Air-Breathing Jet Engine that uses the forward motion of the Engine to compress incoming air (without the use of an axial compressor) and decelerate it to subsonic speeds before adding the fuel and constantly combusting the mixture then expelling the exhaust out through the rear Propelling Nozzle to generate Thrust.

cco:ont00000997.label: Disrupting Disposition
cco:ont00000997.definition: A disposition the realization of which would disrupt a process some entity has an interest in.

cco:ont00000998.label: Telecommunication Network
cco:ont00000998.definition: A Communication System that is designed to enable the transmission of information over significant distances between Telecommunication Endpoints via Telecommunication Network Nodes and Lines.

cco:ont00000999.label: Defunct Stasis
cco:ont00000999.definition: A Stasis of Artifact Operationality that holds during a Temporal Interval when a Material Artifact no longer maintains its designed set of Artifact Functions (or at least no longer maintains its primary functions).

cco:ont00001000.label: Spray Nozzle
cco:ont00001000.definition: A Nozzle that is designed to facilitate a conversion of the flow of a portion of liquid into a dynamic collection of drops dispersed in a portion of gas.

cco:ont00001001.label: Drooping
cco:ont00001001.definition: A Shape Quality inhering in a bearer in virtue of the bearer having a border that hangs downwards.

cco:ont00001002.label: Material Copy of a Message
cco:ont00001002.definition: An Information Bearing Artifact that is designed to carry some specific Information Content Entity that is relatively brief and to be transmitted from a sender to a recipient.

cco:ont00001003.label: Cartridge
cco:ont00001003.definition: A Portion of Ammunition that is designed to package a Bullet, a propellant substance, and a primer within a case that is designed to fit within the firing chamber of a Firearm.

cco:ont00001004.label: Measurement Unit of Electromagnetic Force
cco:ont00001004.definition: A Measurement Unit that is used as a standard for measurement of the electromagnetic force between electrically charged entities.

cco:ont00001005.label: Turbojet Air-Breathing Jet Engine
cco:ont00001005.definition: An Air-Breathing Jet Engine that uses a Turbojet, which consists of a Turbine with a Propelling Nozzle.

cco:ont00001006.label: Operator Role
cco:ont00001006.definition: A Role that inheres in an Agent by virtue of that Agent's responsibilities to operate or control some Material Artifact.

cco:ont00001007.label: Passenger Train Car
cco:ont00001007.definition: A Train Car that is designed to transport passengers.

cco:ont00001008.label: Biological Weapon
cco:ont00001008.definition: A Weapon that is designed to inflict harm, incapacity, or death by means of releasing disease-producing agents—such as bacteria, viruses, or fungi.

cco:ont00001009.label: Optical Telescope
cco:ont00001009.definition: A Telescope that is designed to aid in the observation of spatially distant Objects by means of collecting and focusing visible light to form an enhanced image of the Object.

cco:ont00001010.label: Ordinal Measurement Information Content Entity
cco:ont00001010.definition: A Measurement Information Content Entity that consists of a symbol that places an Entity into some rank order.

cco:ont00001011.label: Automobile
cco:ont00001011.definition: A Ground Motor Vehicle that is designed to transport a small number of passengers while traveling on four tired wheels.

cco:ont00001013.label: Heating Artifact Function
cco:ont00001013.definition: An Artifact Function that is realized in a process in which the thermal energy of a system increases.

cco:ont00001014.label: Proper Name
cco:ont00001014.definition: A Designative Name that is an official name for a particular entity.

cco:ont00001015.label: Controlled-Access Highway
cco:ont00001015.definition: A Highway that is designed for high-speed vehicular traffic, with traffic flow and ingress/egress regulated.

cco:ont00001016.label: Portion of Lithosphere
cco:ont00001016.definition: A fiat object part of the rigid, outermost rocky shell of a natural satellite.

cco:ont00001017.label: Agent
cco:ont00001017.definition: A Material Entity that bears an Agent Capability.

cco:ont00001018.label: Equipment Cooling System
cco:ont00001018.definition: A Cooling System that is designed to cool some piece of equipment.

cco:ont00001019.label: Steering Control System
cco:ont00001019.definition: A Vehicle Control System that is designed to control the direction some Vehicle is traveling.

cco:ont00001020.label: Portion of Gaseous Fuel
cco:ont00001020.definition: A Portion of Fuel that is stored in a gaseous state.

cco:ont00001021.label: Act of Denying
cco:ont00001021.definition: An Act of Representative Communication performed by either asserting that something is not true or real or refusing to satisfy a request or desire.

cco:ont00001022.label: Ratio Measurement Information Content Entity
cco:ont00001022.definition: A Measurement Information Content Entity that consists of a symbol that places a Quality of an Entity onto an interval scale having a true zero value.

cco:ont00001023.label: Calendar Week
cco:ont00001023.definition: A Week that begins and ends concurrently with the Days specified by a Calendar System to be the first and last Days of the Week.

cco:ont00001024.label: Spark Ignition Engine
cco:ont00001024.definition: An Internal Combustion Engine that is designed to operate by generating a spark to ignite a portion of Fuel and Oxidizer mixture.

cco:ont00001025.label: Electric Generator
cco:ont00001025.definition: An Electrical Power Source that is designed to convert mechanical energy to electrical energy for use in an external circuit.

cco:ont00001026.label: Pointing Orientation
cco:ont00001026.definition: A Spatial Orientation of a Material Entity in which one or more of its designated components are oriented toward a specified direction.

cco:ont00001027.label: Trim Tab
cco:ont00001027.definition: A Control Surface that is designed to counteract hydro-, aerodynamic, or other forces in order to stabilize the Vehicle it is part of in the desired Attitude.

cco:ont00001028.label: Mechanical Wave Process
cco:ont00001028.definition: A Wave Process that involves Oscillation of a portion of matter such that energy is transferred through the material medium.

cco:ont00001029.label: Unguided Rocket
cco:ont00001029.definition: A Portion of Ammunition that is designed to be a self-propelled, but unguided, projectile that delivers some payload (explosive or other) over relatively long distances through the use of a Rocket Engine.

cco:ont00001030.label: Train
cco:ont00001030.definition: A Rail Transport Vehicle that consists of a series of connected Train Cars or Railcars.

cco:ont00001031.label: Act of Volunteering
cco:ont00001031.definition: An Act of Commissive Communication performed by voluntarily undertaking or expressing a willingness to undertake a service.

cco:ont00001032.label: Act of Assignment
cco:ont00001032.definition: An Act of Declarative Communication in which rights held by one party (the assignor) are transferred to another party (the assignee) with regard to a particular entity as specified by the details of the assignment, which is often prescribed by a contract.

cco:ont00001033.label: Biological Sex
cco:ont00001033.definition: A Quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's ability to undergo sexual reproduction in order to differentiate the individuals or types involved.

cco:ont00001034.label: Full Motion Video Camera
cco:ont00001034.definition: A Video Camera that is designed to capture and record images of sufficiently high quality and in rapid enough succession that the resulting video supports smooth playback.

cco:ont00001035.label: Pitch Axis
cco:ont00001035.definition: An Axis of Rotation that passes through the center of an object's Mass and is perpendicular both to the direction of the object's motion and to the object's Yaw Axis.

cco:ont00001036.label: Communication System
cco:ont00001036.definition: A Material Artifact that is designed to enable some Act of Communication by means of transmission systems, relay stations, tributary stations, and data terminal equipment, usually capable of interconnection and interoperation to form an integrated whole.

cco:ont00001037.label: Constructed Feature
cco:ont00001037.definition: An Anthropogenic Feature that has been constructed by deliberate human effort.

cco:ont00001038.label: Nickel Cadmium Electric Battery
cco:ont00001038.definition: A Secondary Cell Electric Battery that has a cadmium anode and nickel oxide hydroxide cathode.

cco:ont00001039.label: Act of Repayment
cco:ont00001039.definition: An Act of Financial Instrument Use wherein a Financial Instrument is transferred by an Agent (the Debtor) to another Agent (the Creditor) to decrease the amount the Debtor owes to the Creditor from an earlier Act of Loaning.

cco:ont00001040.label: Nadir
cco:ont00001040.definition: A One-Dimensional Spatial Region that extends from a given location downward along the local vertical direction pointing in the direction of the apparent Gravitational Force at that location.

cco:ont00001041.label: Sequence Position Ordinality
cco:ont00001041.definition: An Ordinal Measurement Information Content Entity that is about the position of some entity in some ordered sequence.

cco:ont00001042.label: Equipment Mount
cco:ont00001042.definition: A Material Artifact that is designed to support a Material Artifact.

cco:ont00001043.label: Aircraft
cco:ont00001043.definition: A Vehicle that is designed to convey passengers, cargo, or equipment from one location to another by air travel.

cco:ont00001044.label: Nuclear Radiation Detection Artifact Function
cco:ont00001044.definition: An Artifact Function that is realized during events in which a Material Artifact is used to detect the presence of nuclear radiation particles.

cco:ont00001045.label: Artifact Model
cco:ont00001045.definition: A Prescriptive Information Content Entity that prescribes a common set of Functions and Qualities to inhere in a set of artifact instances.

cco:ont00001046.label: Material Copy of a Notification Message
cco:ont00001046.definition: A Material Copy of a Message that is designed to carry an Information Content Entity that describes a scenario that has been determined to merit attention by the recipient.

cco:ont00001047.label: Frequency
cco:ont00001047.definition: A Process Profile that is characterized by the number of repetitive processes during a particular time period.

cco:ont00001048.label: Increase of Dependent Continuant
cco:ont00001048.definition: A Change in which some Independent Continuant has an increase in the level of some Dependent Continuant that it bears.

cco:ont00001049.label: Electrical Power Source
cco:ont00001049.definition: A Power Source that is designed to generate, control, and transfer power in the form of electrical energy.

cco:ont00001050.label: Primary Cell Electric Battery
cco:ont00001050.definition: A Electric Battery that is designed for one-time use and not to be recharged.

cco:ont00001051.label: Projectile Launcher
cco:ont00001051.definition: A Weapon that is designed to inflict damage or harm by means of launching a high-velocity projectile at a target.

cco:ont00001052.label: Military Facility
cco:ont00001052.definition: A Facility that is designed to support a Military Force.

cco:ont00001053.label: Act of Collision
cco:ont00001053.definition: An Act of Location Change involving the movement of one object such that it collides with another object.

cco:ont00001054.label: Helical Antenna
cco:ont00001054.definition: A Wire Antenna that consists of a conducting wire wound in the form of a helix that is typically mounted over a ground plane with a feed line connected between the bottom of the helix and the ground plane.

cco:ont00001055.label: Branched
cco:ont00001055.definition: A Shape Quality inhering in a bearer in virtue of the bearer having subdivisions or offshoots.

cco:ont00001056.label: Visible Light Frequency
cco:ont00001056.definition: An Electromagnetic Radiation Frequency of some Electromagnetic Wave that is between 400 and 800 terahertz.

cco:ont00001057.label: Act of Issuing Mass Media Press Release
cco:ont00001057.definition: An Act of Issuing an official statement to one or more members of the media for the purpose of announcing newsworthy information.

cco:ont00001058.label: Hour
cco:ont00001058.definition: A Temporal Interval that is equal to sixty consecutive Minutes.

cco:ont00001059.label: Shape Quality
cco:ont00001059.definition: A Quality that inheres in a bearer in virtue of the ratios between dimensions of external features of that bearer.

cco:ont00001060.label: Fuel System
cco:ont00001060.definition: A Material Artifact that is designed to pump, manage, and deliver some Portion of Fuel to the Propulsion System and Auxiliary Power Unit of some Vehicle.

cco:ont00001061.label: Motorcycle
cco:ont00001061.definition: A Ground Motor Vehicle that is designed to transport a very small number of passengers (usually 1 or 2) while traveling on two or three tired wheels.

cco:ont00001062.label: International Community
cco:ont00001062.definition: A maximal Group of Geopolitical Organizations engaged in geopolitics with one another.

cco:ont00001063.label: Straight
cco:ont00001063.definition: A Shape Quality inhering in a bearer in virtue of the bearer not having curves, bends, or angles along its borders.

cco:ont00001064.label: Material Copy of a Barcode
cco:ont00001064.definition: An Information Bearing Artifact that is designed to carry one or more geometric shapes that concretize some Prescriptive Information Content Entity.

cco:ont00001065.label: Two Dimensional Extent
cco:ont00001065.definition: A Size Quality that inheres in a bearer in virtue of the bearer's extension in two dimensions.

cco:ont00001066.label: Loss of Disposition
cco:ont00001066.definition: A Loss of Realizable Entity in which some Independent Continuant ceases to be the bearer of some Disposition.

cco:ont00001067.label: Laser
cco:ont00001067.definition: A Material Artifact that is designed to emit light coherently through a process of optical amplification based on the stimulated emission of electromagnetic radiation.

cco:ont00001068.label: Gain of Quality
cco:ont00001068.definition: A Gain of Specifically Dependent Continuant in which an Independent Continuant becomes the bearer of some Quality.

cco:ont00001069.label: Representational Information Content Entity
cco:ont00001069.definition: An Information Content Entity that represents some Entity.

cco:ont00001070.label: Fluid Control Artifact Function
cco:ont00001070.definition: An Artifact Function that is realized in processes in which some Material Artifact is used to control the direction or flow of some fluid.

cco:ont00001071.label: Payload Capacity
cco:ont00001071.definition: An Artifact Function that inheres in a Vehicle that is designed to transport Payload, and which is typically characterized by the maximum Weight, Mass, or Volume of Payload that the Vehicle can transport.

cco:ont00001072.label: FM Radio Broadcast Frequency
cco:ont00001072.definition: A Very High Frequency that is between 88 and 108 MHz.

cco:ont00001073.label: Financial Value of Property
cco:ont00001073.definition: Financial Value that inheres in an material entity that is the object of an Act of Ownership.

cco:ont00001074.label: Act of Educational Training Acquisition
cco:ont00001074.definition: An Act of Training Acquisition performed by an Agent by acquiring knowledge of a curriculum from an Agent or communication medium that realizes a capacity derived from its affiliation with some Educational Organization.

cco:ont00001075.label: Act of Training Instruction
cco:ont00001075.definition: An Act of Training performed by an Agent by imparting knowledge to another Agent.

cco:ont00001076.label: Electric Power Station
cco:ont00001076.definition: A Facility that is designed to generate electrical power.

cco:ont00001077.label: Heavy Machine Gun
cco:ont00001077.definition: A Mounted Gun that is designed to fire ammunition greater than .50 caliber or 12.7mm ammunition in quick succession from an ammunition belt, and which typically weighs more than 30lbs.

cco:ont00001078.label: Airport
cco:ont00001078.definition: A Transportation Facility that is designed for launching, receiving, and housing Aircraft.

cco:ont00001079.label: Blond
cco:ont00001079.definition: A Color that ranges from nearly white to a light greyish yellow.

cco:ont00001080.label: Far Infrared Light Frequency
cco:ont00001080.definition: An Infrared Light Frequency that is between 300 gigahertz and 20 terahertz.

cco:ont00001081.label: Geographic Feature
cco:ont00001081.definition: An Environmental Feature that is a natural (i.e. not human made) topographical feature having a (relatively) stable location in some Geospatial Region which can be designated by location-specific data.

cco:ont00001082.label: Patch Receiver
cco:ont00001082.definition: A Radio Receiver that uses a Patch Antenna to intercept radio signals.

cco:ont00001083.label: Air-Breathing Combustion Engine
cco:ont00001083.definition: A Reaction Engine that functions by drawing a continuous stream of air into and through the Engine where it is compressed, mixed with a Portion of Fuel, ignited, and then expelled as exhaust gas.

cco:ont00001084.label: Portion of Processed Material
cco:ont00001084.definition: A Material Artifact that is the output of an Act of Material Artifact Processing.

cco:ont00001085.label: Reflection Artifact Function
cco:ont00001085.definition: An Artifact Function that is realized by a Material Artifact participating in a reflection event in which the Material Artifact causes a change in a wavefront at an interface between the reflecting medium and the transmission medium such that the wavefront returns into the transmission medium.

cco:ont00001086.label: Road Junction
cco:ont00001086.definition: A Land Transportation Artifact that is designed to enable Ground Vehicles to exit one Road and enter another.

cco:ont00001087.label: Orientation Observation Artifact Function
cco:ont00001087.definition: An Observation Artifact Function that is realized during events in which a Material Artifact is used to collect information about the Orientation of a specified object or class of objects.

cco:ont00001088.label: Decade
cco:ont00001088.definition: A Temporal Interval that is equal to a period of ten consecutive Years.

cco:ont00001089.label: Petrochemical Refinery
cco:ont00001089.definition: A Refinery that is designed for refining crude oil, intermediate petroleum products, or synthetic petroleum into products of value.

cco:ont00001090.label: Measurement Unit of Pressure
cco:ont00001090.definition: A Measurement Unit that is used as a standard for measurement of Force applied perpendicular to a surface per unit area.

cco:ont00001091.label: Fort
cco:ont00001091.definition: A Military Facility that is designed to support the defense of or solidification of rule over some Geospatial Region and its inhabitants.

cco:ont00001092.label: Electrical Power Storage Artifact Function
cco:ont00001092.definition: An Electrical Artifact Function that is realized during events in which a Material Artifact is used to store electrical power to be released at a later time.

cco:ont00001093.label: Coin
cco:ont00001093.definition: A Portion of Cash that consists of a flat, portable, round pieces of metal designed to bear some specified Financial Value.

cco:ont00001094.label: Act of Espionage
cco:ont00001094.definition: An Act of Intelligence Gathering involving the obtaining of information that is considered secret or confidential without the permission of the holder of the information.

cco:ont00001095.label: Cellular Telecommunication Network
cco:ont00001095.definition: A Wireless Telecommunication Network where the last link between the network and the end user is wireless and is distributed over service areas called cells.

cco:ont00001096.label: Submachine Gun
cco:ont00001096.definition: An Long Gun that is designed to be have automatic-fire functionality, fire pistol-caliber ammunition that is magazine-fed, and which is usually smaller than other automatic firearms.

cco:ont00001097.label: Common Stock
cco:ont00001097.definition: Stock that entitles its holder to voting on corporate decisions.

cco:ont00001098.label: Hospital
cco:ont00001098.definition: A Healthcare Facility that is designed to provide patient treatment with specialized staff and equipment.

cco:ont00001099.label: Bridge
cco:ont00001099.definition: A Land Transportation Artifact that is designed to span physical obstacles without closing the way underneath to enable Persons or Ground Vehicles to pass over the obstacles.

cco:ont00001100.label: Measurement Artifact Function
cco:ont00001100.definition: An Artifact Function that is realized during events in which a Material Artifact is used to measure one or more features of a specified object or class of objects.

cco:ont00001101.label: Interval Estimate Information Content Entity
cco:ont00001101.definition: An Estimate Information Content Entity that consists of an interval of possible (or probable) values for the measured entity.

cco:ont00001102.label: Commercial Facility
cco:ont00001102.definition: A Facility that is designed for buying and selling goods and services, especially on a large scale.

cco:ont00001103.label: Artifact Model Name
cco:ont00001103.definition: A Designative Information Content Entity that designates some Material Artifact Model.

cco:ont00001104.label: Long Gun
cco:ont00001104.definition: A Firearm that is designed to have a longer barrel than a Hand Gun and to be fired while braced against the shoulder.

cco:ont00001105.label: Secondary Cell Electric Battery
cco:ont00001105.definition: An Electric Battery that is designed to be recharged.

cco:ont00001106.label: Roll Axis
cco:ont00001106.definition: An Axis of Rotation that passes through the center of an object's Mass from the front to the back of the object as defined by the direction of the object's motion.

cco:ont00001107.label: Landfill
cco:ont00001107.definition: A Waste Management Facility that is designed for disposing of waste by burial.

cco:ont00001108.label: Ultra High Frequency
cco:ont00001108.definition: A Microwave Frequency that is between 300 MHz and 3 GHz.

cco:ont00001109.label: Counter-Clockwise Rotational Motion
cco:ont00001109.definition: A Rotational Motion in which the direction of rotation is toward the left as seen relative to the designated side of the plane of rotation.

cco:ont00001110.label: Evening
cco:ont00001110.definition: A Temporal Interval that consists of the temporal regions between when the sun sets (approximately 6:00pm) and when people typically retire to sleep (approximately 9:00pm).

cco:ont00001111.label: Low Midrange Frequency
cco:ont00001111.definition: A Sonic Frequency that is between 250 and 500 Hz.

cco:ont00001112.label: Proper Acceleration
cco:ont00001112.definition: An Acceleration of an object relative to a free-fall, or inertial, observer who is momentarily at rest relative to the object being measured (hence, gravity does not cause Proper Acceleration).

cco:ont00001113.label: Magenta
cco:ont00001113.definition: A Color consisting of red and blue hues.

cco:ont00001114.label: Division of Delimiting Domain
cco:ont00001114.definition: A Geospatial Region that is a fiat division of a Delimiting Domain and not a Delimiting Domain.

cco:ont00001115.label: Private Network Telephone Call
cco:ont00001115.definition: A Telephone Call transmitted over a network where a closed group of telephones are connected primarily to each other and use a gateway to reach the outside world.

cco:ont00001116.label: Reference Time
cco:ont00001116.definition: A Temporal Instant specified as the origin for which other Temporal Regions are measured or identified.

cco:ont00001117.label: Propelling Nozzle
cco:ont00001117.definition: A Nozzle that is used to convert a propulsion Engine into a Jet Engine and functions by using its narrowest part, the throat, to increase Pressure within the Engine by constricting flow, usually until the flow chokes, then expanding the exhaust stream to, or near to, atmospheric pressure, while forming it into a high speed jet to propel the Vehicle.

cco:ont00001118.label: Surface Tension
cco:ont00001118.definition: A Disposition that inheres in a liquid and is realized when the cohesive forces of the molecules in the bearer at the surface are greater than the adhesive forces of the molecules in the surrounding air.

cco:ont00001119.label: Material Copy of a Form Document
cco:ont00001119.definition: A Material Copy of a Document that has one or more Material Copy of a Document Field as parts in which to write or select prescribed content.

cco:ont00001120.label: Act of Religious Training Instruction
cco:ont00001120.definition: An Act of Training Instruction performed by an Agent who realizes a capacity derived from the Agent's affiliation with some Religious Organization by imparting knowledge of the tenets and/or practices of a religion to an Agent either directly or indirectly through some communication medium.

cco:ont00001121.label: Scramjet Engine
cco:ont00001121.definition: An Air-Breathing Jet Engine that uses the forward motion of the Engine to compress incoming air at supersonic speeds before adding the fuel and constantly combusting the mixture then expelling the exhaust out through the rear Propelling Nozzle to generate Thrust.

cco:ont00001122.label: Radio Interference
cco:ont00001122.definition: A Natural Process in which a radio signal is disrupted, whether unintentionally or as the result of an Act of Radio Jamming, Act of Radio Spoofing, or similar Planned Act.

cco:ont00001123.label: Poison Artifact Function
cco:ont00001123.definition: A Damaging Artifact Function that is realized in a process which causes illness in, or the death of, a living thing.

cco:ont00001124.label: Precision-Guided Missile
cco:ont00001124.definition: A Portion of Ammunition that is designed to be a self-propelled and precision-guided projectile that delivers some payload (explosive or other) over relatively long distances.

cco:ont00001125.label: Set of Eyes
cco:ont00001125.definition: A Bodily Component that consists of two or more Eyes that are part of a single Agent.

cco:ont00001126.label: Luminescent Property
cco:ont00001126.definition: An Optical Property that inheres in a bearer in virtue of that bearer's capacity to emit visible light, but which isn't the result of the bearer being heated.

cco:ont00001127.label: Loss of Quality
cco:ont00001127.definition: A Loss of Specifically Dependent Continuant in which some Independent Continuant ceases to be the bearer of some Quality.

cco:ont00001128.label: Act of Residing
cco:ont00001128.definition: An Act of Inhabitancy in which a Person lives in a dwelling permanently or for an extended period of time.

cco:ont00001129.label: Pressurization Control Artifact Function
cco:ont00001129.definition: A Ventilation Control Artifact Function that is realized by processes in which some Material Artifact is used to control the partial pressure of air in some space.

cco:ont00001130.label: Geospatial Polygon
cco:ont00001130.definition: A Geospatial Line String that has at least three vertices where the connecting lines form a closed loop.

cco:ont00001132.label: Stasis of Mission Capability
cco:ont00001132.definition: A Stasis of Realizable Entity that holds during a temporal interval when a Continuant's capability (or lack thereof) to perform its intended Functions, tasks, or Objectives remains at a relatively constant level.

cco:ont00001133.label: Motion
cco:ont00001133.definition: A Natural Process in which a Continuant changes its Location or Spatial Orientation over some Temporal Interval.

cco:ont00001134.label: Vehicle Frame
cco:ont00001134.definition: A Material Artifact that is designed to be the main supporting structure of some Vehicle.

cco:ont00001135.label: Portion of Liquid Fuel
cco:ont00001135.definition: A Portion of Fuel that is stored in a liquid state.

cco:ont00001136.label: Ultrasonic Frequency
cco:ont00001136.definition: A Sound Frequency that is greater than 20 kHz.

cco:ont00001137.label: Radiation Reflectivity
cco:ont00001137.definition: A Disposition to Interact with Electromagnetic Radiation that inheres in a bearer in virtue of the capacity of that bearer to scatter or reflect electromagnetic radiation of a given frequency.

cco:ont00001138.label: Beverage Antenna
cco:ont00001138.definition: A Wire Antenna that consists of a horizontal wire one-half to two wavelengths long that is suspended above the ground with one end attached to the receiver feedline and the other grounded and which is typically used in the low and medium frequency radio bands.

cco:ont00001139.label: Spacecraft
cco:ont00001139.definition: A Vehicle that is designed to convey passengers, cargo, or equipment from one location to another by Spaceflight.

cco:ont00001140.label: Flywheel
cco:ont00001140.definition: A Material Artifact that is designed to store rotational energy such that it has a significant moment of inertia which enables it to resist changes in rotational speed.

cco:ont00001141.label: Infrastructure Role
cco:ont00001141.definition: A Role that inheres in the bearer of a Disposition and has been assigned to an Infrastructure System such that the realization of that Disposition is sometimes part of the functioning of the Infrastructure System.

cco:ont00001142.label: Violet
cco:ont00001142.definition: A Color that is lower than Blue with a wavelength in the visible spectrum typically between 400 and 450 nanometers.

cco:ont00001143.label: Facsimile Transmission
cco:ont00001143.definition: An Act of Communication Mediated by Artifact in which a Document Content Entity is transmitted over a Telephone Network.

cco:ont00001144.label: Act of Entertainment
cco:ont00001144.definition: A Planned Act consisting of any activity which provides a diversion or permits people to amuse themselves.

cco:ont00001145.label: Radio Receiver
cco:ont00001145.definition: A Radio Communication Instrument that is an electronic device that is designed to extract information from radio waves intercepted by a Radio Antenna by using electronic filters to separate the desired radio frequency signal from other signals, an electronic amplifier to increase the power of the signal, and demodulation to recover the desired information.

cco:ont00001146.label: Sidereal Time Reference System
cco:ont00001146.definition: A Temporal Reference System that is based on Earth's rate of rotation measured relative to one or more fixed Stars (rather than the Sun).

cco:ont00001147.label: Act of Violence
cco:ont00001147.definition: A Planned Act of causing harm to oneself or to another through the use of physical or verbal force.

cco:ont00001148.label: Electromagnetic Communication Artifact Function
cco:ont00001148.definition: A Communication Artifact Function that is realized in a process that conveys information by means of electromagnetic radiation.

cco:ont00001149.label: Data Range Interval Estimate Information Content Entity
cco:ont00001149.definition: A Ratio Measurement Information Content Entity that is a measurement of a set of values and is equal to the absolute difference between the largest value and the smallest value in the set.

cco:ont00001150.label: Portion of Ammunition
cco:ont00001150.definition: A Weapon that is designed to inflict harm, damage, or incapacity by being projected toward its target at a significant Velocity.

cco:ont00001151.label: Portion of Paper
cco:ont00001151.definition: An Information Medium Artifact that is designed to bear some Information Content Entity by means of pressing together moist fibres of cellulose pulp derived from wood, rags, or grasses, and drying them into flexible sheets.

cco:ont00001152.label: Government Domain
cco:ont00001152.definition: A Delimiting Domain that delimits the authority of a Government to exercise its control within the bounded area.

cco:ont00001153.label: Damaging Artifact Function
cco:ont00001153.definition: An Artifact Function that is realized in a process in which the structural integrity of an entity is impaired.

cco:ont00001154.label: Multi-Second Temporal Interval
cco:ont00001154.definition: A one-dimensional temporal region that is measured in Seconds and spans at least one Second.

cco:ont00001155.label: Full Motion Video Imaging Artifact Function
cco:ont00001155.definition: An Imaging Artifact Function that inheres in Material Artifacts that are designed to produce video of entities that is of high enough quality to make the represented motion appear continuous to human viewers.

cco:ont00001156.label: Material Copy of a Information Line
cco:ont00001156.definition: An Information Bearing Artifact that consists of a single line or row of some larger Information Bearing Artifact of which it is a part.

cco:ont00001157.label: Hydraulic Power Source
cco:ont00001157.definition: A Power Source that is designed to generate, control, or transmit power by means of pressurized liquid.

cco:ont00001158.label: Act of Data Transformation
cco:ont00001158.definition: An Act of Information Processing in which an algorithm is executed to act upon one or more input Information Content Entities into one or more output Information Content Entities.

cco:ont00001159.label: Bond
cco:ont00001159.definition: A Financial Instrument that is designed to secure an Agent's debt for the holders of that debt.

cco:ont00001160.label: Solvent Artifact Function
cco:ont00001160.definition: A Chemical Reaction Artifact Function that is realized in the dissolving of other substances (namely, solutes) without change in the former's chemical structure.

cco:ont00001161.label: Counterfeit Legal Instrument
cco:ont00001161.definition: A Counterfeit Instrument that is designed to be a fake replica of some genuine Legal Instrument.

cco:ont00001162.label: Act of Commissive Communication
cco:ont00001162.definition: An Act of Communication in which an Agent commits themselves to doing, or refraining from doing, some future action.

cco:ont00001163.label: Measurement Information Content Entity
cco:ont00001163.definition: A Descriptive Information Content Entity that describes the extent, dimensions, quantity, or quality of an Entity relative to some standard.

cco:ont00001164.label: County
cco:ont00001164.definition: A Government Domain that is part of either a First-Order or Second-Order Administrative Region.

cco:ont00001165.label: Terrorist Training Camp
cco:ont00001165.definition: A Training Camp designed to teach students methods of terrorism.

cco:ont00001166.label: Multi-Minute Temporal Interval
cco:ont00001166.definition: A one-dimensional temporal region that is measured in Minutes and spans at least one Minute.

cco:ont00001167.label: Midrange Frequency
cco:ont00001167.definition: A Sonic Frequency that is between 500 Hz and 2 kHz.

cco:ont00001168.label: Reaction Mass
cco:ont00001168.definition: A Material Entity against which a Propulsion System operates in order to produce Acceleration.

cco:ont00001169.label: Communication Relay Artifact Function
cco:ont00001169.definition: A Communication Artifact Function that is realized in processes of first receiving and then transmitting information.

cco:ont00001170.label: Hard X-ray Frequency
cco:ont00001170.definition: An X-Ray Frequency that is between 3 and 30 exahertz.

cco:ont00001171.label: Wireless Network Telephone Call
cco:ont00001171.definition: A Telephone Call transmitted over a network where the telephones are not dependent on a physical connection to the network such that they can continue to operate anywhere within the coverage area.

cco:ont00001172.label: Portion of Gelatinous Propellant
cco:ont00001172.definition: A Portion of Propellant that is stored in a gelatinous state.

cco:ont00001173.label: Rocket Launcher
cco:ont00001173.definition: A Projectile Launcher that is designed to launch one or more Unguided Rockets.

cco:ont00001174.label: Electromagnetic Shielding Artifact Function
cco:ont00001174.definition: An Artifact Function that is realized in a process in which an electromagnetic field is blocked by barriers made of conductive or magnetic materials.

cco:ont00001175.label: Language
cco:ont00001175.definition: A Prescriptive Information Content Entity that prescribes a canonical format for communication.

cco:ont00001176.label: Estimate Information Content Entity
cco:ont00001176.definition: A Measurement Information Content Entity that is a measurement of an entity based on partial information about that entity or an appropriately similar entity.

cco:ont00001177.label: Roll Orientation
cco:ont00001177.definition: A Spatial Orientation of an Object relative to its Roll Axis.

cco:ont00001178.label: Railway Crossing
cco:ont00001178.definition: A Land Transportation Artifact that is designed to enable Persons or Ground Vehicles to cross a Railway when traveling along a road or path that is perpendicular to and at the same elevation as the Railway at the point where they overlap.

cco:ont00001179.label: Digital Storage Device
cco:ont00001179.definition: An Information Medium Artifact that is designed to bear some Information Content Entity by means of recording that information in digital (binary) format.

cco:ont00001180.label: Organization
cco:ont00001180.definition: A Group of Agents which can be the bearer of roles, has members, and has a set of organization rules.

cco:ont00001181.label: Triple Inertial Navigation System
cco:ont00001181.definition: An Inertial Navigation System that is designed to use three redundant computers to continuously calculate via dead reckoning the position, orientation, and velocity of a moving object without the need for external references, in such a way that eliminates the need for a navigator.

cco:ont00001182.label: Phase Angle
cco:ont00001182.definition: A Relational Quality that is the angle between the light incident onto an observed Object and the light reflected from the Object.

cco:ont00001183.label: Social Network
cco:ont00001183.definition: A Group of Agents that are connected in dyadic relations by similar personal or career interests, activities, backgrounds, or real-life connections.

cco:ont00001184.label: Spinning Motion
cco:ont00001184.definition: A Rotational Motion of an Object around an Axis of Rotation that passes through the Object's Center of Mass.

cco:ont00001185.label: Rocket
cco:ont00001185.definition: A Vehicle that is designed to travel through air or space and which obtains Thrust from a Rocket Engine.

cco:ont00001186.label: Color Hue
cco:ont00001186.definition: An Optical Property that inheres in a bearer in virtue of its capacity to reflect a dominant wavelength of the visible light spectrum, which is typically divided up into 6 to 8 ranges.

cco:ont00001187.label: Navigation System
cco:ont00001187.definition: A Material Artifact that is designed to enable an Agent or Material Artifact to determine the position or direction of some object, usually for the purpose of monitoring or controlling the movement of some Vehicle from one place to another.

cco:ont00001188.label: Denture
cco:ont00001188.definition: A Prosthesis that is designed to replace missing teeth.

cco:ont00001189.label: Blue
cco:ont00001189.definition: A Color that is between Cyan and Violet with a wavelength in the visible spectrum typically between 450 to 490 nanometers.

cco:ont00001190.label: Telephone Call
cco:ont00001190.definition: An Act of Communication Mediated by Artifact in which sound is used to communicate over a telephone network to one or more recipients.

cco:ont00001191.label: Operational Stasis
cco:ont00001191.definition: A Stasis of Artifact Operationality that holds during a Temporal Interval when a Material Artifact maintains its designed set of Artifact Functions (or at least maintains its primary functions).

cco:ont00001192.label: Radio Antenna
cco:ont00001192.definition: A Bidirectional Transducer that is designed to convert electric power into radio waves, and radio waves into electric power.

cco:ont00001193.label: Fatigability
cco:ont00001193.definition: A Realizable Entity that is realized when its bearer loses strength and tires quickly.

cco:ont00001194.label: Gain of Role
cco:ont00001194.definition: A Gain of Realizable Entity in which some Independent Continuant becomes bearer of some Role.

cco:ont00001195.label: Geospatial Error Region
cco:ont00001195.definition: A One-Dimensional Geospatial Boundary that bounds some Geospatial Region according to probability estimations for locating some object within it.

cco:ont00001196.label: Act of Artifact Assembly
cco:ont00001196.definition: An Act of Material Artifact Processing wherein a new Material Artifact are created by fitting component parts together.

cco:ont00001197.label: Anthropogenic Feature
cco:ont00001197.definition: An Environmental Feature that is related to or is the result of the influence of human beings on the environment.

cco:ont00001198.label: Railcar
cco:ont00001198.definition: A Rail Transport Vehicle that consists of a single self-propelled Vehicle that is not a Train, is designed to transport passengers, and which may also be designed to connect to other Railcars to form a Train.

cco:ont00001199.label: Protruding
cco:ont00001199.definition: A Shape Quality inhering in a part of an object in virtue of the part extending out above or beyond the surface of the object.

cco:ont00001200.label: Structural Support Artifact Function
cco:ont00001200.definition: An Artifact Function that is realized by a Material Artifact providing physical support to another object.

cco:ont00001201.label: Trail
cco:ont00001201.definition: A Land Transportation Artifact that is designed to enable transport through rough country, such as a forest or moor.

cco:ont00001202.label: Size Quality
cco:ont00001202.definition: A Quality that inheres in a bearer in virtue of the bearer's extension in one or more dimensions.

cco:ont00001203.label: Delimiting Domain
cco:ont00001203.definition: A Geospatial Region that delimits the authority of an Organization to exercise its control within the bounded area.

cco:ont00001204.label: Night
cco:ont00001204.definition: A Temporal Interval that consists of the temporal regions between when people typically retire to sleep (approximately 9:00pm) and when the sun dawns (approximately 6:00am).

cco:ont00001205.label: Priority Scale
cco:ont00001205.definition: A Reference System that is designed to be used to rank or identify the importance of entities of the specified type.

cco:ont00001206.label: Multi-Year Temporal Interval
cco:ont00001206.definition: A one-dimensional temporal region that is measured in Years and spans at least one Year.

cco:ont00001207.label: Optical Lens
cco:ont00001207.definition: An Optical Instrument that is designed to focus or disperse a beam of light entering the lens by means of refraction.

cco:ont00001208.label: High Frequency
cco:ont00001208.definition: A Radio Frequency that is between 3 and 30 MHz.

cco:ont00001210.label: Retail Artifact Function
cco:ont00001210.definition: A Service Artifact Function that is realized in processes of selling goods or merchandise in small or individual lots for direct consumption by persons or organizations.

cco:ont00001211.label: Lifting Artifact Function
cco:ont00001211.definition: An Artifact Function that is realized by processes in which some Material Artifact is used to lift some object.

cco:ont00001212.label: Female Sex
cco:ont00001212.definition: A Biological Sex inhering in an individual that only produces gametes that can be fertilized by male gametes.

cco:ont00001213.label: Stasis of Artifact Operationality
cco:ont00001213.definition: A Stasis of Realizable Entity that holds during a Temporal Interval when a Material Artifact's designed set of Artifact Functions (or at least its primary functions) or the realizations of those functions remain unchanged.

cco:ont00001214.label: Increase of Specifically Dependent Continuant
cco:ont00001214.definition: An Increase of Dependent Continuant in which some Independent Continuant has an increase of some Specifically Dependent Continuant that it bears.

cco:ont00001215.label: Funeral
cco:ont00001215.definition: An Act of Ceremony in which the Life of a Person who has died is celebrated, sanctified, or remembered.

cco:ont00001216.label: Periscope
cco:ont00001216.definition: An Optical Instrument that is designed to enable observation of an object that is located over, around, or through another object, obstacle, or condition that prevents direct line-of-sight observation from the observer's current position.

cco:ont00001217.label: Medium Machine Gun
cco:ont00001217.definition: A Mounted Gun that is designed to fire full-power rifle Cartridges (less than .50 caliber or 12.7mm) in quick succession from an ammunition belt, and which typically weighs 22-30 lbs.

cco:ont00001218.label: Signal Processing Artifact Function
cco:ont00001218.definition: An Artifact Function that is realized in the process of transferring or processing information contained in signals.

cco:ont00001219.label: Delta-v
cco:ont00001219.definition: A Process Profile that is the total change in Velocity of an object's Motion.

cco:ont00001220.label: Opaque
cco:ont00001220.definition: An Opacity that inheres in a bearer in virtue of that bearer's incapacity to transmit electromagnetic radiation of a given frequency through the bearer such that the bearer reflects, scatters, or absorbs all electromagnetic radiation of that frequency.

cco:ont00001221.label: Physically Powered Engine
cco:ont00001221.definition: An Engine that is designed to convert potential or kinetic energy into mechanical energy.

cco:ont00001222.label: Solar Panel System
cco:ont00001222.definition: An Electrical Power Source that consists in part of one or more Solar Panels, a power inverter, electrical wiring between the components, a mounting and support structure, and may also include a battery and/or a solar tracking system and is the bearer of functions realized in processes of deriving, transferring, and storing electrical energy derived from light energy.

cco:ont00001223.label: Dish Receiver
cco:ont00001223.definition: A Radio Receiver that uses a Parabolic (or Dish) Antenna to intercept radio signals.

cco:ont00001224.label: Process Requirement
cco:ont00001224.definition: A Process Regulation that requires some Process.

cco:ont00001225.label: Yellow
cco:ont00001225.definition: A Color that is between Orange and Green with a wavelength in the visible spectrum typically between 560 to 590 nanometers.

cco:ont00001226.label: Act of Employment by an Organization
cco:ont00001226.definition: An Act of Employment wherein an Organization assigns a set of activities to some Person to be performed in exchange for financial compensation.

cco:ont00001227.label: Longitudinal Wave Profile
cco:ont00001227.definition: A Wave Process Profile in which the displacement of participating particles is parallel to the direction of the Wave Process' propogation such that the particles alternate between participating in processes of compression and rarefaction as they participate in individual Wave Processes.

cco:ont00001228.label: Material Copy of a Journal Article
cco:ont00001228.definition: A Material Copy of a Document that is designed to carry a specific brief composition on a specific topic as part of a Journal Issue.

cco:ont00001229.label: Alkaline Electric Battery
cco:ont00001229.definition: A Primary Cell Electric Battery that has a Zinc anode and Manganese (IV) oxide cathode.

cco:ont00001230.label: Rhombic Antenna
cco:ont00001230.definition: A Wire Antenna that consists of one to three parallel wires suspended above the ground by poles or towers at each vertex in a rhombic shape with each of the four sides being the same length (typically at least one wavelength or longer).

cco:ont00001231.label: Brilliance Frequency
cco:ont00001231.definition: A Sonic Frequency that is between 6 and 20 kHz.

cco:ont00001232.label: Act of Possession
cco:ont00001232.definition: A Planned Act in which an agent intentionally exercises control towards a thing.

cco:ont00001233.label: Crushing Artifact Function
cco:ont00001233.definition: A Damaging Artifact Function that is realized in a process in which the structural integrity of an entity is impaired because of significant pressure.

cco:ont00001234.label: Neutralization Artifact Function
cco:ont00001234.definition: A Chemical Reaction Artifact Function that is realized in a process in which an acid and a base react quantitatively with each other.

cco:ont00001235.label: Military Time Zone Identifier
cco:ont00001235.definition: A Time Zone Identifier that designates a spatial region where the local time is calculated according to the specified offset from Zulu time, which has no offset from Coordinated Universal Time.

cco:ont00001236.label: Act of Suicide
cco:ont00001236.definition: An Act of Violence in which some Agent intentionally and voluntarily causes their own death.

cco:ont00001237.label: Birth
cco:ont00001237.definition: A Process of bringing forth offspring.

cco:ont00001238.label: Initialism
cco:ont00001238.definition: An Abbreviated Name that consists of the initial letters of some words (or syllables) in a Designative Name, and in which each letter is pronounced separately.

cco:ont00001239.label: Group of Organizations
cco:ont00001239.definition: A Group of Agents that has only Organizations as member parts.

cco:ont00001240.label: Radio Communication Artifact Function
cco:ont00001240.definition: An Electromagnetic Communication Artifact Function that is realized in a process that conveys information by means of radio waves.

cco:ont00001241.label: Sensor Function
cco:ont00001241.definition: A Function that is realized in processes wherein an attribute of its bearer is a proxy for some aspect of its sensing environment.

cco:ont00001242.label: Actuator
cco:ont00001242.definition: A Transducer that is designed to convert some control signal into mechanical motion.

cco:ont00001243.label: Material Copy of a Document Field
cco:ont00001243.definition: An Information Bearing Entity that is a part of some document into which carriers of prescribed information can be written or selected.

cco:ont00001244.label: Act of Issuing Mass Media Article
cco:ont00001244.definition: An Act of Issuing a non-fictional essay, especially one included with others in a newspaper, magazine, or journal.

cco:ont00001246.label: Under Active Control
cco:ont00001246.definition: An Active Stasis during which a Material Artifact participates in an Act of Artifact Employment.

cco:ont00001247.label: Telecommunication Endpoint
cco:ont00001247.definition: A Telecommunication Network Node that connects a Telecommunication Terminal to a Telecommunication Network.

cco:ont00001248.label: Artificial Eye
cco:ont00001248.definition: A Prosthesis that is designed to replace a missing eye.

cco:ont00001249.label: Cabin Pressurization Control System
cco:ont00001249.definition: An Environment Control System that is designed to control the process in which conditioned air is pumped into the Cabin of some Aircraft or Spacecraft in order to create a safe and comfortable environment for passengers and crew flying at high altitudes.

cco:ont00001250.label: Interior Lighting System
cco:ont00001250.definition: A Lighting System that is designed to emit light within the interior of some area.

cco:ont00001251.label: Act of Intelligence Gathering
cco:ont00001251.definition: A Planned Act of producing and/or gathering information by a government or other Organization to guide decisions and actions by answering questions or obtaining advance warning of events and movements deemed to be important or otherwise relevant.

cco:ont00001252.label: Propulsion Artifact Function
cco:ont00001252.definition: A Motion Artifact Function that is realized in a process in which the bearer of the function creates force leading to an entity's movement.

cco:ont00001253.label: Fuel Artifact Function
cco:ont00001253.definition: An Artifact Function that is realized in processes in which a Portion of Fuel is reacted with other substances in order to release chemical or nuclear energy to be used for heat or for work.

cco:ont00001254.label: Revolver
cco:ont00001254.definition: A Hand Gun having a number of firing chambers in a revolving cylinder, where each chamber in the cylinder can be loaded with a single Cartridge.

cco:ont00001255.label: Insecticide Artifact Function
cco:ont00001255.definition: A Pesticide Artifact Function that is realized in a process that causes harm to, or the death of, an insect.

cco:ont00001256.label: Reliability Measurement Information Content Entity
cco:ont00001256.definition: A Measurement Information Content Entity that is a measurement of the extent to which an entity can consistently produce an outcome.

cco:ont00001257.label: Nuclear Storage Depot
cco:ont00001257.definition: A Storage Facility that is designed to store nuclear material.

cco:ont00001258.label: Port
cco:ont00001258.definition: A Transportation Facility that is designed to contain harbors for docking Watercraft and for transfering people or cargo to and from land.

cco:ont00001259.label: Portion of Atmosphere
cco:ont00001259.definition: A fiat object part of the layer of gas or layers of gases that envelop a natural satellite.

cco:ont00001261.label: Act of Identifying
cco:ont00001261.definition: An Act of Representative Communication performed by asserting who or what a particular person or thing is.

cco:ont00001262.label: Person
cco:ont00001262.definition: An Animal that is a member of the species Homo sapiens.

cco:ont00001263.label: Act of Issuing Mass Media Documentary
cco:ont00001263.definition: An Act of Issuing information that provides a factual record or report.

cco:ont00001265.label: Public Address System
cco:ont00001265.definition: A Communication System that is designed to allow a Person to speak to a large audience.

cco:ont00001266.label: Act of Vocational Training Instruction
cco:ont00001266.definition: An Act of Training Instruction performed by an Agent who realizes a capacity derived from the Agent's affiliation with a Vocational School, Technical School, Trade Organization, or Industry Educational Program Provider by imparting skills required for a specific occupation in industry, agriculture or trade to an Agent either directly or indirectly through some communication medium.

cco:ont00001267.label: Act of Propaganda
cco:ont00001267.definition: An Act of Deceptive Communication Propaganda intended to influence the attitude of a mass audience toward some cause or position by presenting facts selectively (thus possibly lying by omission) or by using loaded messages to produce an emotional rather than rational response to the information presented.

cco:ont00001269.label: Act of Warning
cco:ont00001269.definition: An Act of Directive Communication performed by indicating a possible or impending danger, problem, or other unpleasant situation.

cco:ont00001270.label: Howitzer
cco:ont00001270.definition: A Cannon that is designed to have a relatively short barrel and to use relatively small propellant charges to propel projectiles in relatively high trajectories with a steep angle of descent.

cco:ont00001271.label: Wired Communication Relay Artifact Function
cco:ont00001271.definition: A Communication Relay Artifact Function that is realized during events in which a Material Artifact is used to first receive and then transmit information by means of wires from one Material Artifact to another for the purpose of communiction.

cco:ont00001272.label: Act of Murder
cco:ont00001272.definition: An Act of Homicide with malice aforethought.

cco:ont00001274.label: Infrasonic Frequency
cco:ont00001274.definition: A Sound Frequency that is below 20 Hz.

cco:ont00001275.label: Nominal Speed Artifact Function
cco:ont00001275.definition: A Speed Artifact Function that is realized in some process in which the Artifact bearing the Artifact Function attains a speed that does not exceed some specified tolerance of that Material Artifact.

cco:ont00001276.label: Carrier Air Wing
cco:ont00001276.definition: A Military Force that is trained and equipped to conduct air operations while embarked on an aircraft carrier.

cco:ont00001277.label: Red
cco:ont00001277.definition: A Color that is above Orange with a wavelength in the visible spectrum typically between 635 to 700 nanometers.

cco:ont00001278.label: Stock
cco:ont00001278.definition: A Financial Instrument that entitles holders to an ownership interest (equity) in the specified Incorporated Organization.

cco:ont00001279.label: Vibration Motion
cco:ont00001279.definition: A Motion wherein some participant repetitively deviates from a central location to two surrounding locations.

cco:ont00001280.label: Flat
cco:ont00001280.definition: A Shape Quality inhering in a bearer in virtue of the bearer having a horizontal border without a significant deviation.

cco:ont00001281.label: Emulsifier Artifact Function
cco:ont00001281.definition: A Chemical Reaction Artifact Function that is realized in a process in which two or more liquids that are normally immiscible are mixed.

cco:ont00001282.label: Hydraulic Valve
cco:ont00001282.definition: A Valve that is designed to regulate, direct, or control the flow of a liquid by opening, closing, or partially obstructing various passageways.

cco:ont00001283.label: Refinery
cco:ont00001283.definition: A Factory that is designed for refining raw materials into products of value.

cco:ont00001284.label: Crew
cco:ont00001284.definition: A Group of Persons that bear Roles realized by the operation of the specified Vehicle.

cco:ont00001285.label: Revolving Motion
cco:ont00001285.definition: A Rotational Motion of an Object around an Axis of Rotation that is located externally to the Site occupied by the Object.

cco:ont00001286.label: Waveform
cco:ont00001286.definition: A Wave Process Profile that is the shape of the Wave Cycles of the Wave Process when depicted in a visual graph.

cco:ont00001287.label: Maintenance Facility
cco:ont00001287.definition: A Facility that is designed to be used to perform actions to maintain or improve the state of some property or equipment.

cco:ont00001288.label: Round Shot
cco:ont00001288.definition: A Portion of Ammunition that is designed to be a solid projectile without explosive charge and to be fired from a cannon.

cco:ont00001289.label: Damaged Stasis
cco:ont00001289.definition: A Stasis of Specifically Dependent Continuant in which some Independent Continuant bears a Quality or Realizable Entity that has suffered impairment (i.e., a decrease or loss) due to a previous action or event such that the Independent Continuant is now of lesser value, usefulness, or functionality.

cco:ont00001290.label: Measurement Unit of Length
cco:ont00001290.definition: A Measurement Unit that is used as a standard for measurement of one-dimensional regions or Geospatial Regions.

cco:ont00001291.label: Radiation Absorptivity
cco:ont00001291.definition: A Disposition to Interact with Electromagnetic Radiation that inheres in a bearer in virtue of the capacity of that bearer to absorb electromagnetic radiation of a given frequency.

cco:ont00001292.label: Bus
cco:ont00001292.definition: A Ground Motor Vehicle that is designed to transport a large number of people and to travel on six or more tired wheels.

cco:ont00001293.label: Perimeter
cco:ont00001293.definition: A One Dimensional Extent that inheres in a bearer in virtue of the extent of a boundary which encloses the bearer.

cco:ont00001294.label: Three Dimensional Extent
cco:ont00001294.definition: A Size Quality that inheres in a bearer in virtue of the bearer's extension in three dimensions.

cco:ont00001295.label: Financial Facility
cco:ont00001295.definition: A Facility that is designed to support the management of money.

cco:ont00001296.label: Pitch Orientation
cco:ont00001296.definition: A Spatial Orientation of an Object relative to its Pitch Axis.

cco:ont00001297.label: Military Headquarters Facility
cco:ont00001297.definition: A Military Facility that is designed for military administration and coordination.

cco:ont00001298.label: Material Copy of a Document
cco:ont00001298.definition: An Information Bearing Artifact that is designed to carry some specific Information Content Entity in a series of paragraphs of text or diagrams in the form of physical pieces of paper or an electronic word processor file.

cco:ont00001299.label: Wetting Agent Artifact Function
cco:ont00001299.definition: A Surfactant Artifact Function that is realized in a process that reduces the water repellent tendency of a substance thereby allowing it to become wet.

cco:ont00001300.label: Patch Antenna
cco:ont00001300.definition: A Radio Antenna that consists of a flat rectangular sheet (or patch) of metal mounted over a larger sheet of metal called a ground plane which is typically contained inside a plastic radome for protection and is small enough that it can be mounted on a flat surface.

cco:ont00001301.label: Service Artifact Function
cco:ont00001301.definition: An Artifact Function that is realized in a process of providing intangible goods to consumers.

cco:ont00001302.label: Civil Organization
cco:ont00001302.definition: An Organization that is not commercial or military and is the bearer of a Civilian Role.

cco:ont00001303.label: Position Observation Artifact Function
cco:ont00001303.definition: An Observation Artifact Function that is realized during events in which a Material Artifact is used to collect information about the position of a specified object or class of objects.

cco:ont00001304.label: Dimension Specification
cco:ont00001304.definition: An Quality Specification that prescribes some Size Quality.

cco:ont00001305.label: Loss of Function
cco:ont00001305.definition: A Loss of Disposition in which some Independent Continuant ceases to be the bearer of some Function.

cco:ont00001306.label: Observation Artifact Function
cco:ont00001306.definition: An Artifact Function that is realized during events in which a Material Artifact is used to collect information about a specified object or class of objects.

cco:ont00001307.label: Measurement Unit of Mass Flow Rate
cco:ont00001307.definition: A Measurement Unit of Flow that is used as a standard for measurement of the rate at which the Mass of a substance passes per unit time.

cco:ont00001308.label: Sewage Treatment Facility
cco:ont00001308.definition: A Waste Management Facility that is designed for removing contaminants from wastewater, especially sewage.

cco:ont00001309.label: Lot Number
cco:ont00001309.definition: A Code Identifier that designates a particular quantity or lot of material from a single manufacturer.

cco:ont00001310.label: Covering Artifact Function
cco:ont00001310.definition: An Artifact Function that is realized in a process in which an entity is covered.

cco:ont00001311.label: Aircraft Manufacturing Facility
cco:ont00001311.definition: A Factory that is designed to manufacture Aircraft.

cco:ont00001312.label: Paramilitary Force
cco:ont00001312.definition: An Armed Force whose organizational structure, training, subculture, and (often) function are similar to those of a professional Military, and which is not included as part of a Government's formal Armed Forces.

cco:ont00001313.label: Article of Clothing
cco:ont00001313.definition: A Material Artifact that is designed to cover some portion of a body.

cco:ont00001314.label: Legal System Act
cco:ont00001314.definition: A Planned Act performed by an Agent that realizes their role within the context of a legal system of some jurisdiction.

cco:ont00001315.label: Waste Management Facility
cco:ont00001315.definition: A Facility that is designed for managing waste for some portion of the waste's existence.

cco:ont00001316.label: Gimbal
cco:ont00001316.definition: An Equipment Mount that consists of a pivoted support that allows a Material Artifact to Rotate about one or more Axes.

cco:ont00001317.label: Measurement Unit of Volume
cco:ont00001317.definition: A Measurement Unit that is used as a standard for measurement of sites or three-dimensional spatial regions.

cco:ont00001318.label: Yaw Orientation
cco:ont00001318.definition: A Spatial Orientation of an Object relative to its Yaw Axis.

cco:ont00001319.label: Tank
cco:ont00001319.definition: An Armored Fighting Vehicle that is designed to carry heavy firepower, have a powerful Engine, and travel on one or more continuous tracks such that it is suitable for front-line combat and can provide operational maneuverability as well as tactical offensive and defensive capabilities.

cco:ont00001320.label: Radio Transceiver
cco:ont00001320.definition: A Radio Communication Instrument that is an electronic device composed of both a Radio Transmitter and a Radio Receiver that share common circuitry or a single housing.

cco:ont00001321.label: Lead Acid Electric Battery
