cco:ont00001321.definition: A Secondary Cell Electric Battery that has a lead anode and lead oxide cathode.

cco:ont00001322.label: Decrease of Generically Dependent Continuant
cco:ont00001322.definition: A Decrease of Dependent Continuant in which some Independent Continuant has a decrease in the level of a Generically Dependent Continuant that it bears.

cco:ont00001323.label: Bearing Artifact Function
cco:ont00001323.definition: An Artifact Function that is realized in processes in which the Material Artifact constrains relative motion to only the desired motion, and reduces friction between moving parts.

cco:ont00001324.label: Process Regulation
cco:ont00001324.definition: A Prescriptive Information Content Entity that prescribes an Process as required, prohibited, or permitted, and is the output of an Process which realizes some Authority Role.

cco:ont00001325.label: Act of Renting
cco:ont00001325.definition: An Act of Purchasing wherein a Financial Instrument is used by an Agent (the Renter) as a payment to acquire temporary possession or use of a good or property that is owned or controlled by another Agent (the Seller).

cco:ont00001326.label: Land Transportation Artifact
cco:ont00001326.definition: A Transportation Artifact that facilitates the movement of Agents and Vehicles via land

cco:ont00001327.label: Social Act
cco:ont00001327.definition: A Planned Act having an objective that affects, is performed by, or is performed on behalf of, a community or group of Persons.

cco:ont00001328.label: Temporal Reference System
cco:ont00001328.definition: A Reference System that describes a set of standards for measuring time as well as understanding the context of and organizing temporal data.

cco:ont00001329.label: Education Artifact Function
cco:ont00001329.definition: A Service Artifact Function that is realized in processes of transmiting accumulated knowledge skills and values from one generation to another.

cco:ont00001330.label: Telemetry Process
cco:ont00001330.definition: A Mechanical Process that is highly automated and in which measurements are made or other data is collected and transmitted to receiving equipment to facilitate the monitoring of environmental conditions or equipment parameters at a remote or inaccessible location.

cco:ont00001331.label: Legal Name
cco:ont00001331.definition: A Proper Name that is an official name for the designated entity as determined by a Government or court of law.

cco:ont00001332.label: Extreme Ultraviolet Light Frequency
cco:ont00001332.definition: An Ultraviolet Light Frequency that is between 3 and 30 petahertz.

cco:ont00001333.label: Rosy
cco:ont00001333.definition: A Color consisting of red hue and yellow hue and high brightness.

cco:ont00001334.label: Act of Purchasing
cco:ont00001334.definition: An Act of Financial Instrument Use wherein a Financial Instrument is used by an Agent (the Purchaser) to acquire a good or service from another Agent (the Provider).

cco:ont00001335.label: Government
cco:ont00001335.definition: An Organization that is the highest legitimate authority delimited by some Delimiting Domain and that exercises executive, legislative, or judicial authority in that Domain.

cco:ont00001336.label: Act of Ownership
cco:ont00001336.definition: An Act of Possession that includes an agent having certain rights and duties over the property owned.

cco:ont00001337.label: Infrared Light Frequency
cco:ont00001337.definition: An Electromagnetic Radiation Frequency of some Electromagnetic Wave that is between 300 gigahertz and 430 tetrahertz.

cco:ont00001338.label: Timbre
cco:ont00001338.definition: A Sound Process Profile that is characterized by the variation, spectrum, or envelope of translated sound waves, typically on a continuum from dull or dark to bright.

cco:ont00001339.label: Act of Walking
cco:ont00001339.definition: An Act of Travel that proceeds by foot.

cco:ont00001340.label: Calendar Date Identifier
cco:ont00001340.definition: A Date Identifier that designates some Day by using a combination of Day, Week, Month, or Year Identifiers formatted according to an implementation of a Calendar System.

cco:ont00001341.label: Portion of Geosphere
cco:ont00001341.definition: A fiat object part that is composed of one or more portions of the atmosphere, cryosphere, hydrosphere, or lithosphere.

cco:ont00001342.label: Infantry Fighting Vehicle
cco:ont00001342.definition: An Armored Fighting Vehicle that is designed to carry infantry into battle and to provide fire support for them.

cco:ont00001343.label: Circuit Breaker
cco:ont00001343.definition: A Material Artifact that is designed to protect an electrical circuit from damage caused by excess current from an overload or short circuit.

cco:ont00001344.label: Biological Depot
cco:ont00001344.definition: A Storage Facility that is designed to store biological agents.

cco:ont00001345.label: Measurement Unit of Impulse
cco:ont00001345.definition: A Measurement Unit that is used as a standard for measurement of the integral of a Force applied to a portion of matter over a temporal interval.

cco:ont00001346.label: Legal Instrument
cco:ont00001346.definition: A Material Artifact that is designed as a formally executed written document that can be formally attributed to its author, records and formally expresses a legally enforceable act, process, or contractual duty, obligation, or right, and therefore evidences that act, process, or agreement.

cco:ont00001347.label: Behavior
cco:ont00001347.definition: An Act in which an Independent Continuant participates as an Agent in response to external or internal stimuli and following some pattern which is dependent upon some combination of that Independent Continuant's internal state and external conditions.

cco:ont00001348.label: Three-Dimensional Position
cco:ont00001348.definition: A Three-Dimensional Spatial Region that encompasses the (minimal) spatial region in which some object is located at a particular time.

cco:ont00001349.label: Grey
cco:ont00001349.definition: A Color between white and black colors.

cco:ont00001350.label: Thermal Control Artifact Function
cco:ont00001350.definition: An Artifact Function that is realized by a Material Artifact increasing, decreasing, or maintaining the temperature of itself, a part of itself, or another object.

cco:ont00001351.label: Cartesian Coordinate System
cco:ont00001351.definition: A Spatial Reference System that identifies each point in a spatial region of n-dimensions using an ordered n-tuple of numerical coordinates that are the signed (i.e. positive or negative) distances measured in the same unit of length from the zero point where the fixed perpendicular Coordinate System Axes meet.

cco:ont00001352.label: Greenwich Mean Time Zone Identifier
cco:ont00001352.definition: A Time Zone Identifier that designates a spatial region where the local time is calculated according to the specified offset from Greenwich Mean Time.

cco:ont00001353.label: Speed Artifact Function
cco:ont00001353.definition: A Motion Artifact Function that is realized in some process in which its bearer has some speed.

cco:ont00001354.label: Vermilion
cco:ont00001354.definition: A Color consisting of red and orange hue with a slight amount of gray.

cco:ont00001355.label: Freight Train Car
cco:ont00001355.definition: A Train Car that is designed to transport cargo.

cco:ont00001356.label: Increase of Disposition
cco:ont00001356.definition: An Increase of Realizable Entity in which some Independent Continuant has an increase of some Disposition that it bears.

cco:ont00001357.label: Measurement Unit of Time
cco:ont00001357.definition: A Measurement Unit that is used as a standard for measurement of temporal regions.

cco:ont00001358.label: School
cco:ont00001358.definition: An Education Facility that is designed to provide learning space and environments for teaching of students under the direction of teachers.

cco:ont00001359.label: Act of Manufacturing
cco:ont00001359.definition: An Act of Material Artifact Processing wherein Material Artifacts are mass produced in a Facility for the purpose of being sold or distributed to consumers.

cco:ont00001360.label: Three Dimensional Shape
cco:ont00001360.definition: A Shape Quality that inheres only in a three dimensional entity.

cco:ont00001361.label: Healing Artifact Function
cco:ont00001361.definition: An Artifact Function that is realized in a process in which health is restored to an unbalanced, diseased, or damaged organism.

cco:ont00001362.label: Gas Processing Facility
cco:ont00001362.definition: A Refinery that is designed for refining natural gas into products of value.

cco:ont00001363.label: Male Sex
cco:ont00001363.definition: A Biological Sex inhering in an individual whose sex organs contain only male gametes.

cco:ont00001364.label: Interval Measurement Information Content Entity
cco:ont00001364.definition: A Measurement Information Content Entity that places a Quality of an Entity onto some interval scale having no true zero value.

cco:ont00001365.label: Maximum Speed Artifact Function
cco:ont00001365.definition: A Speed Artifact Function that is realized in some process in which the Material Artifact bearing the Artifact Function attains the highest speed at which that Material Artifact is designed to operate.

cco:ont00001366.label: Powering Artifact Function
cco:ont00001366.definition: An Artifact Function that is realized by processes in which some Material Artifact is used to supply power to some Material Artifact.

cco:ont00001367.label: One Dimensional Extent
cco:ont00001367.definition: A Size Quality that inheres in a bearer in virtue of the bearer's extension in one dimension.

cco:ont00001368.label: Motion Observation Artifact Function
cco:ont00001368.definition: An Observation Artifact Function that is realized during events in which a Material Artifact is used to collect information about the Motion of a specified object or class of objects.

cco:ont00001369.label: Rectangular
cco:ont00001369.definition: A Shape Quality inhering in a bearer in virtue of having four sides and four 90 degree angles.

cco:ont00001370.label: Machine Bearing
cco:ont00001370.definition: A Material Artifact that is designed to constrain relative motion to only desired motion and reduces friction between moving parts.

cco:ont00001371.label: Electromagnetic Induction Artifact Function
cco:ont00001371.definition: An Artifact Function that is realized by processes in which some Material Artifact that is used to produce electromotive force across an electrical conductor due to its dynamic interaction with a magnetic field.

cco:ont00001372.label: Fertilizer Artifact Function
cco:ont00001372.definition: An Enhancing Artifact Function that is realized in processes of supplying soilds or plant tissues with one or more plant nutrients essential to growth.

cco:ont00001373.label: Bow
cco:ont00001373.definition: A Projectile Launcher that is designed to launch Arrows.

cco:ont00001374.label: Act of Declarative Communication
cco:ont00001374.definition: An Act of Communication that changes the reality in accord with the content of the declaration.

cco:ont00001375.label: Washing Facility
cco:ont00001375.definition: A Facility that is designed to wash personnel or equipment.

cco:ont00001376.label: Torque
cco:ont00001376.definition: A Force that is applied to an object in a direction that would tend to cause the object to rotate around an Axis of Rotation and is the rate of change of an object's Angular Momentum.

cco:ont00001377.label: Gold Color
cco:ont00001377.definition: A Color that resembles a yellow-orange Hue with the added feature of having a metallic shine.

cco:ont00001378.label: Hospitality Artifact Function
cco:ont00001378.definition: A Service Artifact Function that is realized in processes of accommodation food and beverage meeting and events gaming entertainment and recreation tourism services and visitor information.

cco:ont00001379.label: Agent Capability
cco:ont00001379.definition: A Realizable Entity that inheres in a Material Entity in virtue of that Material Entity's capacity to realize it in some Planned Act.

cco:ont00001380.label: Farm
cco:ont00001380.definition: An Agricultural Facility that is designed to produce food and other crops.

cco:ont00001381.label: Medical Artifact
cco:ont00001381.definition: A Material Artifact that is designed for diagnosing, treating, or preventing disease, disability, or death.

cco:ont00001382.label: Electronic Cash
cco:ont00001382.definition: A Portion of Cash that consists of Bytes.

cco:ont00001383.label: Fire Station
cco:ont00001383.definition: A Public Safety Facility that is designed for the storage of firefighting apparatus.

cco:ont00001384.label: Opacity
cco:ont00001384.definition: A Disposition to Interact with Electromagnetic Radiation that inheres in a bearer in virtue of that bearer's capacity to transmit electromagnetic radiation of a given frequency through the bearer instead of reflecting, scattering, or absorbing electromangentic radiation of that frequency.

cco:ont00001999.label: Filter Function
cco:ont00001999.definition: An Artifact Function that is realized in a process where entities of a specific type or which have specified properties enter it or pass through it.

cco:ont00002000.label: Center of Mass
cco:ont00002000.definition: A Fiat Point that is where the weighted position vectors of the distributed Mass of a Material Entity relative to this point sum to zero.

cco:ont00002001.label: Media Content Entity
cco:ont00002001.definition: An information content entity presented in a canonical media format.

cco:ont00002002.label: Certificate
cco:ont00002002.definition: A Media Content Entity that attests to certain demonstrated characteristics of an Object, Person, or Organization.

cco:ont00002003.label: Academic Degree
cco:ont00002003.definition: A Certificate issued by an Educational Organization to a Person to indicate that the Person has satisfactorily completed a course of study, or as an honorary recognition of the Person's achievement.

cco:ont00002004.label: Image
cco:ont00002004.definition: A Media Content Entity represents some entity owing to a visual isomorphism between the carrying artifact and the entity.

cco:ont00002005.label: Chart
cco:ont00002005.definition: An Image that is prescribed by some canonical visual format.

cco:ont00002006.label: Database
cco:ont00002006.definition: A Media Content Entity that is designed to be rapidly searchable and retrievable.

cco:ont00002007.label: List
cco:ont00002007.definition: A Media Content Entity whose parts are the subject of some Sequence Position Ordinality.

cco:ont00002008.label: Code List
cco:ont00002008.definition: A List whose parts are Code Identifiers.

cco:ont00002009.label: Video
cco:ont00002009.definition: A Media Content Entity that contains a sequence of representations that are presented sufficiently rapidly to create the appearance of motion and continuity.

cco:ont00002010.label: Message
cco:ont00002010.definition: A Media Content Entity that is relatively brief and designed to be transmitted from a sender to a recipient.

cco:ont00002011.label: Warning Message
cco:ont00002011.definition: A Message that describes a possible or impending threat.

cco:ont00002012.label: Email Message
cco:ont00002012.definition: A Message that is transmitted to the recipient's Email Box.

cco:ont00002013.label: Notification Message
cco:ont00002013.definition: A Message that describes a scenario that has been determined to merit attention by the recipient.

cco:ont00002014.label: Barcode
cco:ont00002014.definition: A Media Content Entity that represents one or more geometric shapes that have, as part, some Prescriptive Information Content Entity.

cco:ont00002037.label: Information Line
cco:ont00002037.definition: A Media Content entity consisting of a single line or row in some Document Content entity of which it is a part.

cco:ont00002038.label: Document Field Content
cco:ont00002038.definition: A Media Content Entity that is a part of some document content entity, and which  prescribes the eliciation of information to be written or selected within the document content entity.

cco:ont00002039.label: Document Content Entity
cco:ont00002039.definition: A Media Content Entity that consists of a series of paragraphs of text or diagrams that are intended to be carried by physical pieces of paper or an electronic word processor file.

cco:ont00002040.label: Book
cco:ont00002040.definition: A Document Content Entity that canonically appears as ink on paper or parchment, or other materials fastened together to hinge at one side.

cco:ont00002041.label: Transcript
cco:ont00002041.definition: A Document Content Entity that was originally recorded in a different medium.

cco:ont00002042.label: Spreadsheet
cco:ont00002042.definition: A Document Content Entity that canonically appears as a interactive, tabular form.

cco:ont00002043.label: Report
cco:ont00002043.definition: A Document Content entity that conveys an account of some event, situation, or the result of some observation or inquiry.

cco:ont00002044.label: Form Document
cco:ont00002044.definition: A Document Content Entity that has Document Field Contents as parts.

cco:ont00002045.label: Journal Article
cco:ont00002045.definition: A Document Content Entity that is part of a Journal Issue.

cco:ont00002066.label: Explosive Mine
cco:ont00002066.definition: An Explosive Weapon that is designed to be concealed and to detonate as its target passes near it.

cco:ont00002067.label: Explosive Naval Mine
cco:ont00002067.definition: An Explosive Mine that is designed to be concealed on or under water.

cco:ont00002068.label: Display Instrument
cco:ont00002068.definition: A Material Artifact that is designed to bear an Image Display Artifact Function.

cco:ont00002069.label: Image Display Artifact Function
cco:ont00002069.definition: An Artifact Function that inheres in Material Artifacts that are designed to display an Image.

cco:ont00002070.label: Email Address
cco:ont00002070.definition: A Designative Name created in order to identify some Email Box as the destination of an email message for the purpose of Email Messaging.

cco:ont00002071.label: Act of Employment
cco:ont00002071.definition: An Act of Association wherein an Agent assigns a set of activities to some Person to be performed in exchange for financial compensation.

cco:ont00002073.label: Sensor Role
cco:ont00002073.definition: A Role that inheres in an entity in virtue of it being used in a process wherein an attribute of its bearer acts as a proxy for some aspect of its sensing environment.

cco:ont00002074.label: Sensor Platform Role
cco:ont00002074.definition: A Role that inheres in an entity in virtue of it being used to support or convey a Sensor during its deployment and functioning.

cco:ont00002075.label: Sensing Process
cco:ont00002075.definition: A Process that realizes a Sensor Function or Sensor Role.

cco:ont00002076.label: Act of Communication Mediated by Artifact
cco:ont00002076.definition: An Act of Communication in which technology is used to create a new copy of the Information Content Entity in the recipient.

cco:ont00002077.label: Act of Publishing
cco:ont00002077.definition: An Act of Mass Media Communication involving the preparation and public issuance of information.

cco:ont00002078.label: Act of Issuing
cco:ont00002078.definition: An Act of Mass Media Communication involving sending forth, distributing, or putting into circulation some Information Content Entity.

cco:ont00002079.label: Communication Transmission Artifact Function
cco:ont00002079.definition: A Communication Artifact Function that is realized in a process of sending information.

cco:ont00002082.label: Act of Refrain
cco:ont00002082.definition: A Planned Act in which some Agent avoids or stops themselves from participating in some Planned Act.

cco:ont00002083.label: Act of Censuring
cco:ont00002083.definition: An Act of Expressive Communication performed by expressing strong disapproval or criticism.
